## 概述

本文由IIT动态腿足系统实验室提出ViTAL（Vision-Based Terrain-Aware Locomotion），一种面向四足机器人攀爬任务的在线全身运动规划框架。核心贡献在于将姿态适应从“优化相对给定落脚点的身体姿态”转变为“寻找最大化腿部到达安全落脚点机会的姿态”，通过共享的落脚点评估准则（FEC，含地形粗糙度、腿部碰撞、运动学可行性、足端轨迹碰撞）统一VFA与VPA两个模块，并采用CNN近似昂贵评估以支持实时优化。在90 kg HyQ与140 kg HyQReal上验证了爬楼梯、间隙等任务，引入滚动时域姿态优化与积分代价函数增强对状态漂移的鲁棒性，但未考虑身体-环境碰撞，且未与RL控制器集成。

## 它改变了什么

这篇论文真正改变的不是“又提出一个能爬楼梯的四足控制器”，而是把姿态适应（pose adaptation）从“跟随落脚点的被动反应”翻转成了“为落脚点创造条件的主动规划”。这个范式转变值得行家注意：传统解耦式规划里，落脚点选择是主角，姿态只是配角——先定脚，再调身体去够那些脚。但真实机器人有执行偏差，脚没踩到预定位置，姿态再优化也可能陷入“无脚可落”的僵局。ViTAL 的 VPA 反其道而行之：不问你“给定这些脚，身体该怎么摆”，而是问“身体摆到哪，能让四条腿都有最多的安全落脚点可选”。这等于把姿态从优化目标变成了优化手段，从“适应地形”变成了“创造可达性”。

## 概述

本文提出SimpleVLA-RL，一种通过强化学习（RL）扩展视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型训练规模的方法。核心贡献在于将RL作为VLA训练的主驱动范式，替代传统依赖静态数据集的行为克隆，从而在复杂操作任务中实现更高的泛化性与样本效率。

## 它改变了什么

VLA训练长期受限于“数据饥渴”与“分布外失效”两大瓶颈。此前主流做法是收集海量专家演示，通过监督式行为克隆拟合策略，但这类方法在遇到未见过的物体位姿、光照变化或任务变体时，性能急剧下降。SimpleVLA-RL改变了这一范式：它不再将RL视为微调阶段的辅助手段，而是将其作为VLA训练的核心引擎，让模型在与环境交互中通过奖励信号自主探索行为空间。这一转变的实质是，从“模仿已知”转向“发现未知”，使策略具备真正的闭环适应能力，而非静态数据集的插值器。

## 方法拆解

### 整体架构
SimpleVLA-RL采用“预训练VLA骨干 + RL策略头”的两阶段设计。预训练阶段使用大规模跨域数据（如Open X-Embodiment）学习通用视觉-语言表征；RL阶段冻结骨干网络，仅训练轻量级策略头与价值头，以降低优化难度。

### 关键设计决策
- **奖励设计**：采用稀疏任务奖励 + 密集进度奖励的混合形式。进度奖励基于当前状态与目标状态的距离变化，由预训练VLA模型提供语义特征空间中的距离度量，而非原始像素或关节角空间。
- **策略优化**：使用PPO（Proximal Policy Optimization）作为RL算法，但引入**自适应熵正则**——当策略在环境中表现不稳定时自动增大熵系数，鼓励探索；当策略性能收敛时减小熵系数，促进利用。
- **重放缓冲机制**：RL训练中维护一个跨任务共享的重放缓冲，存储成功与失败轨迹。失败轨迹并非简单丢弃，而是通过VLA模型重新标注为“负样本”，用于训练…

## Overview
Scaling robot learning requires massive, diverse trajectory data, yet collection is currently bottlenecked by physical teleoperation, where every demonstration binds operator time to specific hardware and workspaces. We introduce digital teleoperation, a paradigm that decouples data collection from physical constraints by replacing the real robot with a generative world model. ent_paper_freeform_preference_learning_f.summary: arXiv:2606.32027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reward design remains a central bottleneck for autonomous robot policy improvement, especially in long-horizon manipulation tasks where sparse success labels provide too little signal and binary preferences collapse many competing notions of quality into one ambiguous signal. We introduce Freeform Preference Learning (FPL), a method for learning robot policies from freeform human preferences. Rather than asking annotators which of two trajectories is better overall, FPL lets them define natural-language preference axes, such as speed, safety, quality of placement, or carefulness, and provide pairwise preferences along each axis. These annotations are used to learn a language-conditioned reward model that maps a trajectory and preference label to an axis-specific reward. We use this model to train a reward-conditioned policy that optimizes across the multiple human-specified dimensions. Across four real-world and two simulated long-horizon manipulation tasks, FPL improves over sparse-reward and binary-preference methods by 38 percentage points. Beyond improved performance, FPL learns dense progress signals without explicit subtask segmentation, shows compositionality of behavior not present in the data, and allows users to steer the policy towards different behaviors at test time without retraining. Blog post with videos available at https://freeform-pl.github.io/fpl.website/
ent_paper_freeform_preference_learning_f.body:
## 概述

FPL（Freeform Preference Learning）由论文作者提出，是一种面向机器人操作的多维偏好学习方法。它允许标注者沿任意任务相关轴（如速度、小心程度）提供自然语言描述的二元偏好，并据此学习语言条件奖励模型与奖励条件策略，从而在真实世界长视野任务中显著超越现有基线，并支持测试时的行为可操控性。

## 它改变了什么

机器人策略学习长期受困于奖励设计的瓶颈。稀疏成功标签信号过少，而标准二元偏好又迫使标注者将速度、小心程度、任务完成度等相互竞争的质量概念压缩进一个模糊的“总体”判断中。这种做法在长视野任务中尤其有害——监督信号既难以提供，又充满歧义，最终将负担转嫁给强化学习算法，使其难以扩展到更真实的行为约束。

FPL真正改变的是“偏好”的定义方式。它不再要求标注者给出一个综合性的二元判断，而是允许其自由指定判断轴（如“是否碰了盘子”或“速度是否够快”），并沿该轴提供偏好。这一转变将监督信号从一维标量扩展为多维、可分解的语言条件形式，使奖励模型能够捕捉理想行为的多个方面，并让策略在训练后仍可通过指定不同轴组合进行测试时操控，而无需重新训练。

## 方法拆解

### 奖励模型学习
- 将 Bradley-Terry 模型扩展为轴条件形式。奖励模型 r_φ 以轴标签 l_k 为条件，对轨迹对 (τ_i, τ_j) 输出标量，最小化负对数似然：
  ℒ_FPL-Reward(φ) = −𝔼[Σ_{k=1}^{K_ij} log σ((2y_k−1)(r_φ(τ_i|l_k) − r_φ(τ_j|l_k)))]
- 轨迹级奖励定义为前缀段得分之和：r_φ(τ, l_k) = Σ_{i=1}^{T} g_φ(o_{1:i}, l_k)。其中 g_φ 是多模态 transformer，以观测历史为条件，而非单帧，以捕捉时间依赖。

## Overview
Parkour is a grand challenge for legged locomotion that requires robots to overcome various obstacles rapidly in complex environments. Existing methods can generate either diverse but blind locomotion skills or vision-based but specialized skills by using reference animal data or complex rewards. 本文提出对抗运动先验（AMP）框架，将物理模拟角色的任务规范与风格规范解耦，通过对抗判别器从大规模非结构化运动数据中学习任务无关的运动先验，无需运动规划器或任务特定标注。该框架结合GAIL与PPO，在Bullet仿真中训练34 DoF人形、59 DoF T-Rex和64 DoF狗，实现多样技能的组合与泛化。

## 它改变了什么

此前基于运动跟踪的方法（如Peng et al. 2018a; Lee et al. 2019）依赖精心设计的模仿目标函数，且需将策略与特定参考运动同步（如相位变量），当面对大型多样数据集时，还需运动规划器为场景选择合适目标，带来显著算法开销与标注负担。对抗模仿方法（如GAIL）虽免去手动设计目标，但训练不稳定且运动质量远落后于跟踪方法，且先前对抗方法（如Peng et al. 2019b）因需相位变量同步，仅能模仿单个运动片段。

AMP真正改变的是：让策略直接从非结构化运动数据中学习运动先验，自动组合与泛化不同技能，无需显式运动选择机制。它将风格奖励建模为任务无关的判别器，使同一算法能同时学习执行多种技能及在给定场景中选择哪种技能，消除了先前系统（如Liu et al. 2012; Park et al. 2019）所需的单独运动规划器或手动标注。这一转变将运动合成从“跟踪特定参考”范式推向“学习行为分布”范式。

## Overview
Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly execute long-horizon mobile manipulation through open-loop action chunks, issuing multiple actions without receiving new high-level visual input. ent_paper_structured_4d_latent_predictiv.summary: arXiv:2607.01166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Video predictive models are emerging as a powerful paradigm in robotics, offering a promising path toward task generalization, long-horizon planning, and flexible decision-making. However, prevailing approaches often operate on 2D video sequences, inherently lacking the 3D geometric understanding necessary for precise spatial reasoning and physical consistency. We introduce a Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model, which predicts the evolution of a scene's 3D structure in a structured latent space conditioned on observations and textual instructions. Our representation encodes the scene holistically and can be decoded into diverse 3D formats, enabling a more complete and 3D consistent scene understanding. This structured 4D latent predictive model serves as a planner, generating future scenes that are translated into executable actions by a goal-conditioned inverse dynamics module. Experiments demonstrate that our model generates futures with strong visual quality, substantially better 3D consistency and multi-view coherence compared to state-of-the-art video-based planners. Consequently, our full planning pipeline achieves superior performance on complex manipulation tasks, exhibits robust generalization to novel visual conditions, and proves effective on real-world robotic platforms. Our website is available at https://structured-4d-model.github.io/.

## Overview
Finetuning a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) on robot demonstrations via behavior cloning (BC) has become the standard recipe for vision-language-action (VLA) policies. ## Overview
Embodied agents face a fundamental limitation: once deployed in real-world environments, they cannot easily acquire new knowledge to improve task performance. In this paper, we propose Dejavu, a general post-deployment learning framework that augments a frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy with retrieved execution memories through an Experience Feedback Network (EFN). EFN identifies contextually relevant prior action experiences and conditions action prediction on the retrieved guidance. We train EFN with reinforcement learning and semantic similarity rewards, encouraging the predicted actions to align with past behaviors under the current observation. ## Overview
Training a high-dimensional simulated agent with an under-specified reward function often leads the agent to learn physically infeasible strategies that are ineffective when deployed in the real world. To mitigate these unnatural behaviors, reinforcement learning practitioners often utilize complex reward functions that encourage physically plausible behaviors. However, a tedious labor-intensive tuning process is often required to create hand-designed rewards which might not easily generalize across platforms and tasks. We propose substituting complex reward functions with "style rewards" learned from a dataset of motion capture demonstrations. A learned style reward can be combined with an arbitrary task reward to train policies that perform tasks using naturalistic strategies…

## Overview
Achieving versatile humanoid locomotion with a single policy presents a critical scalability challenge. Prevailing methods often rely on distilling multiple terrain-specific teacher policies into a unified student policy. However, while such distillation captures basic locomotion primitives, it struggles to organically compose these skills to adapt to complex environments, resulting in poor generalization to novel composite terrains unseen during training. To overcome this, we present DreamPolicy, a unified framework that integrates offline data with a diffusion-based world model, enabling a single policy to master both known and unseen terrains. ## Overview
Despite recent advances in robust locomotion, bipedal robots operating in the real world remain at risk of falling. While most research focuses on preventing such events, we instead concentrate on the phenomenon of falling itself. Specifically, we aim to reduce physical damage to the robot while providing users with control over a robot's end pose. To this end, we propose a robot agnostic reward function that balances the achievement of a desired end pose with impact minimization and the protection of critical robot parts during reinforcement learning. ## Overview

EgoVLA proposes a new paradigm for learning Vision-Language-Action models (VLA) from first-person human videos, pretraining on approximately 500K image-action pairs and then fine-tuning with a small number of robot demonstrations to achieve cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. Its core contribution lies in demonstrating that the human action space and robot action space can be approximated through a unified MANO parameterization, thereby breaking through the scale bottleneck of robot data collection and significantly surpassing the ACT baseline on the Isaac simulation benchmark.

## Overview

Whole-body control of humanoid robots in complex interaction scenarios has long been a core challenge in robotics. Traditional methods rely on precise physical modeling and handcrafted control strategies, which struggle to adapt to dynamic, unstructured real-world environments. By decomposing complex tasks into routable hierarchical skills and expert strategies, it achieves efficient mapping from visual perception to whole-body motion generation. ## Overview

This paper focuses on a core challenge in state estimation for humanoid robots—the legged odometry problem—and proposes a learning-based contact representation method. Traditional model-based contact detection often lacks robustness in complex terrains and dynamic motions, leading to drift in pose estimation. By introducing a data-driven approach to learn high-dimensional representations of contact states, this study aims to improve the self-localization accuracy and stability of humanoid robots in unknown environments, providing a reliable state foundation for subsequent motion control and navigation tasks.

## Overview
World models are a powerful paradigm in AI and robotics, enabling agents to reason about the future by predicting visual observations or compact latent states. The 1X World Model Challenge introduces an open-source benchmark of real-world humanoid interaction, with two complementary tracks: sampling, focused on forecasting future image frames, and compression, focused on predicting future discrete latent codes. ent_paper_finn_one_shot_visual_imitation.body:
## 概述

本文提出一种面向车载边缘计算（VEC）中截止期限约束任务卸载与资源分配问题（DOAP）的近似算法 SARound，将最佳已知近似比从 1/6 提升至 1/4，并配套设计了在线服务订阅与自适应卸载控制框架及 VecSim 模拟器。核心贡献在于同时考虑调度开销、服务初始化与快速变化的无线信道质量，并通过线性规划舍入与局部比率技术实现理论保证与工程可行性的平衡。

## 它改变了什么

该工作真正改变的是 VEC 任务卸载问题中“理论最优性”与“实际可部署性”之间的割裂状态。此前研究要么忽略调度开销和服务初始化对任务执行时间的影响，要么假设无线网络质量在决策周期内保持静态，这两种简化在真实 5G V2X 场景中都会导致卸载决策严重偏离实际。作者将信道质量变化纳入问题建模，并显式处理服务部署的二进制决策变量，使得近似比从 1/6 到 1/4 的改进不仅是一个理论数字，而是对更贴近物理现实的约束集合下仍能保持性能的证明。

另一个关键改变在于对“在线”含义的重新定义。现有工作多聚焦于单轮静态优化，而本文提出的在线服务订阅框架针对短任务截止期限（约 10 ms 量级）和毫秒级信道波动，将服务部署与资源分配解耦为不同时间尺度的决策，这更符合实际 VEC 系统中控制面与数据面分离的架构需求。此外，开发 VecSim 模拟器填补了现有工具（如 iFogSim、EdgeCloudSim）无法同时支持 5G 网络模拟、集成计算卸载模型与在线控制接口的空白，为后续研究提供了可复现的验证平台。

### 问题建模
- 系统模型：VEC 系统由 \( M \) 个 RSU（集合 \( \mathcal{M} \)）与一个集中式调度器构成。每个 RSU 包含 5G 模块（管理带宽资源）与服务器（提供计算资源），计算资源以计算单元（CUs）度量，带宽以资源块（RBs）度量。…

## Overview
Autonomous driving requires generating safe and reliable trajectories from complex multimodal inputs. ent_paper_implicit_kinodynamic_motion_re.name: Implicit Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting for Human-to-humanoid Imitation Learning
ent_paper_implicit_kinodynamic_motion_re.name_en: Implicit Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting for Human-to-humanoid Imitation Learning
ent_paper_implicit_kinodynamic_motion_re.summary: Implicit Kinodynamic Motion Retargeting for Human-to-humanoid Imitation Learning is a 2025 work on loco-manipulation and whole-body-control for humanoid robots.
ent_paper_implicit_kinodynamic_motion_re.body:
## 概述

本文提出隐式运动动力学重定向框架（IKMR），用于将人类运动数据高效转化为物理可行的人形机器人全身控制信号。该方法结合预训练运动拓扑特征表示与强化学习动力学微调，在Unitree G1平台上实现5000fps的实时重定向速度，比数值优化方法快近100倍，同时保证输出运动的物理可行性。

## 它改变了什么

当前人类到人形机器人的模仿学习面临根本性瓶颈：人类运动数据丰富（动捕、视频、生成模型），但人形机器人数据稀缺，且现有重定向方法无法规模化利用这些数据。运动学方法逐帧处理、忽略动态约束，产出物理上不可行的运动；动力学方法需手动设计约束、计算成本高；隐式神经网络方法仅关注虚拟化身，同样不考虑物理可行性。作者真正改变的是将“运动学映射”与“动力学可行性”统一到一个可扩展的端到端框架中，使大规模人类数据能够直接服务于人形机器人物理控制，而非停留在虚拟角色动画层面。这一转变意味着重定向不再是一次性的离线预处理，而是可以与下游强化学习策略训练无缝衔接的实时组件。

## 方法拆解

### 网络架构
- 对称双自编码器结构，每个编码器-解码器包含静态块与动态块
- 静态块处理骨架偏移S ∈ ℝ^{J×S}（3D向量表示），动态块拼接静态特征后对整个运动序列Q ∈ ℝ^{T×J×Q}（单位四元数表示局部旋转）进行时间卷积
- 重定向过程：Q̂_B = D_φ^B(E_θ^A(Q_A, S_A), S_B)，即源运动编码、目标骨架解码

### 预训练阶段
- 损失函数：L_pretrain = L_recon + λ_align·L_align + λ_consis·L_consis
- 拓扑对齐损失对齐人类与人形机器人的潜在特征空间，重建损失学习压缩编码，潜在一致性损失作为正则化
- 关键设计：放弃直接拟合关节角度和位置，寻求特征层面的一致性；假设源骨架和目标骨架同胚…

ent_paper_li_crayonrobo_object_centric_p.body:
## 概述

CrayonRobo 是一个面向铰接物体操作的物体中心提示驱动视觉-语言-动作模型，通过蓝点、红/绿/黄线等视觉提示编码接触点与夹爪方向，并引入正交性与提示-方向相关性损失提升 3D 位姿预测精度。在 PartNet-Mobility 基准上，已见类别成功率 0.74、未见类别 0.72，显著优于 RT-Trajectory 复现结果。

## 它改变了什么

铰接物体操作长期被当作通用抓取问题的特例处理，但 RT-Trajectory 这类轨迹条件模型在旋转估计上暴露了根本缺陷：pick-and-place 中末端执行器旋转模式相对统一，而铰接物体（如按钮、杠杆、抽屉）需要多样且精细的旋转调整，仅靠 2D 轨迹图像无法传递足够的 3D 方向信息。CrayonRobo 真正改变的是将“提示”从被动条件升级为主动监督信号——不仅告诉模型“去哪里”，还明确“以什么姿态接触”，并通过损失函数将 2D 提示与 3D 方向强耦合，迫使模型在视觉特征与几何约束之间建立可泛化的映射。这一转变使得模型在未见物体类别上的表现几乎不衰减，说明方向提示比轨迹提示更接近铰接物体交互的本质结构。

## 方法拆解

### 输入提示设计
- 四种变体（a/b/c/d）逐步增加信息量：蓝点标记接触点，红线表示夹爪 z 轴 2D 方向，绿线表示夹爪 y 轴 2D 方向，黄线表示移动 2D 方向
- Ground truth 包含接触点、夹爪 z 轴 3D 方向、夹爪 y 轴 3D 方向、移动 3D 方向

### 损失函数
- ℒ_T：基础损失，监督 3D 位姿预测
- ℒ_O：正交性损失，显式强制 z 轴与 y 轴方向正交（物理上夹爪两轴必然垂直）
- ℒ_P：提示-方向相关性损失，捕捉 2D 提示与 3D 方向之间的映射关系

### 训练与推理
- 骨干网络：LLaMA-adapte…

## Overview
We address the problem of understanding when and why Vision-Language-Action models struggle with contact-rich manipulation tasks that require precise physical interaction. Prior work has primarily focused on addressing contact failures through force-augmented architectures and training-time regularizers, yet the root causes of these failures remain underexplored. We identify two distinct failure modes underlying this gap. Precision failures are rooted in a flow-matching policy training mismatch, and force failures arise from the distinctive structure of force signals. ent_paper_huang_a3vlm_actionable_articul.body:
## Overview
Vision Language Models (VLMs) have received significant attention in recent years in the robotics community. VLMs are shown to be able to perform complex visual reasoning and scene understanding tasks, which makes them regarded as a potential universal solution for general robotics problems such as manipulation and navigation. However, previous VLMs for robotics such as RT-1, RT-2, and ManipLLM have focused on directly learning robot-centric actions. Such approaches require collecting a significant amount of robot interaction data, which is extremely costly in the real world. Thus, we propose A3VLM, an object-centric, actionable, articulation-aware vision language model. A3VLM focuses on the articulation structure and action affordances of objects. ent_paper_tram_global_trajectory_motion_.body:
## Overview

TRAM proposes a two-stage framework that recovers the global trajectory (SE(3) root trajectory) and local body motion (SMPL pose) of a 3D human from in-the-wild videos captured by a moving camera. The core contribution lies in combining robust, metric-scale Masked DROID-SLAM with VIMO, a video Transformer human motion regressor, achieving a Root Trajectory Error (RTE) of 3.1m on EMDB—approximately 60% lower than the state of the art—while significantly outperforming existing methods in pose accuracy (PA-MPJPE 38.1mm).

## What It Changes

This paper focuses on the problem of interactive character animation control for humanoid robots, proposing a motion analysis and synthesis framework based on Control Operators. By introducing modular control operators, it achieves efficient modeling and dynamic synthesis of complex human motion. ent_paper_guided_motion_diffusion_for_co.body:
## 概述

本文提出OTTER架构，通过显式文本感知的视觉特征提取，在保持预训练CLIP编码器完全冻结的前提下，选择性传递与语言指令语义对齐的视觉信息给策略网络，从而解决VLA模型微调破坏预训练语义对齐的问题。该方法在仿真和真实世界机器人拾取-放置任务中显著优于Octo和OpenVLA基线，展现出对未见物体和环境的强零样本泛化能力。

## 它改变了什么

现有VLA模型（如Octo、OpenVLA）将视觉和语言特征独立编码后送入策略网络，这实际上破坏了预训练VLM中已经建立的语义对齐关系。更关键的是，直接微调预训练VLM（如RT-2、OpenVLA）会干扰预训练特征，因为机器人数据集的语义多样性远低于大规模视觉-语言数据集（如LAION），导致在未见物体或环境上性能显著下降。

作者提出的核心质疑是：是否更优策略是提取并利用预训练对齐，而非通过微调削弱它。这改变了VLA领域“微调即一切”的默认假设，将问题从“如何更好地适应机器人数据”转向“如何保留并利用大规模预训练中已有的语义知识”。这一视角转换对数据效率、泛化能力和部署实用性都有深远影响。

## 方法拆解

### 架构总览
OTTER的核心是显式、文本感知的视觉特征提取（text-aware visual feature extraction），而非处理所有视觉特征。

### 分步流程
1. **特征提取**：每个时间步t，从预训练CLIP模型提取文本感知视觉特征f_vl（见图3）。
2. **注意力池化**：f_vl和文本token f_l分别通过独立的注意力池化层压缩，得到f'_vl和f'_l。
3. **本体感觉编码**：机器人本体感觉由MLP层编码为embodiment表示f_e。
4. **特征拼接**：f'_l、f'_vl、f_e拼接形成f_t，作为策略transformer的输入。

## Overview

## Overview

MIGHTY is a UAV trajectory planner proposed by the MIT ACL team based on quintic Hermite splines. Through joint spatiotemporal optimization and local derivative control, it significantly reduces travel time while ensuring collision avoidance and dynamic feasibility. Its core contribution lies in introducing derivative variable reparameterization and scaling techniques, achieving a 100% success rate in both complex static and dynamic environments, with computational efficiency superior to mainstream methods such as GCOPTER and EGO-Planner.

## Overview
Cross-embodiment generalization underpins the vision of building generalist embodied agents for any robot, yet its enabling factors remain poorly understood. ent_paper_vlm_ar3l_vision_language_model.name: VLM-AR3L: Vision-Language Models for Absolute and Relative Rewards in Reinforcement Learning
ent_paper_vlm_ar3l_vision_language_model.name_en: VLM-AR3L: Vision-Language Models for Absolute and Relative Rewards in Reinforcement Learning
ent_paper_vlm_ar3l_vision_language_model.summary: arXiv:2607.00483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing effective reward functions remains a major challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), particularly in open-ended environments where task goals are abstract and difficult to quantify. In this work, we present VLM-AR3L, a framework that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to provide both absolute and relative rewards for RL. VLM-AR3L interprets an agent's visual observations in the context of a natural language task goal, and learns both absolute and relative rewards from VLM-generated preference labels. The absolute reward model predicts scalar evaluations for individual states, while the relative reward model compares consecutive observations to infer progress or regression toward the task goal. Their integration combines the stability of state-based evaluation with the robustness of comparative supervision. We evaluate VLM-AR3L across benchmarks spanning classic control, manipulation, and open-world embodied tasks, with a particular focus on Minecraft given its visual complexity and long-horizon decision-making requirements. Experimental results show that VLM-AR3L consistently outperforms prior VLM-based reward learning methods.

## Overview

ent_paper_li_llara_supercharging_robot_l.summary: LLaRA: Supercharging Robot Learning Data for Vision-Language Policy (LLaRA), is a 2024 large vision-language-action model for robotic manipulation, introduced by Stony Brook University, University of Wisconsin-Madison, and published at ICLR 2024.
ent_paper_li_llara_supercharging_robot_l.body:
## 概述

LLaRA 提出 Interactive Language 框架，将实时语言引导视为大规模模仿学习问题，通过高吞吐量 play 式数据收集与事件可选事后重标注，训练出能响应开放词汇指令的视觉-语言-运动策略 LAVA。真实世界实验表明，该策略能以 93.5% 成功率处理 87,000 条独特命令，并支持单操作员同时引导四台机器人。

## 它改变了什么

现有机器人语言操作研究大多停留在开环预设指令序列，即任务开始前给定完整指令，执行中不再接受新的自然语言反馈。这种设定回避了真实人机协作中最具价值的交互模式：人类在任务执行过程中根据观察到的状态，实时给出纠正性或引导性语言。LLaRA 真正改变的是将语言从“任务描述”提升为“实时控制信号”，使策略能够在执行中吸收新的指令并调整行为，从而解锁了诸如单人多机协同、长时程复杂任务纠错等此前难以实现的能力。

这一转变的代价是数据收集范式必须重构。传统演示收集要求每个 episode 对应一个明确任务，而实时交互需要覆盖任意时刻可能出现的语言指令。LLaRA 采用 play 式收集与事后重标注，将连续行为流切分为语言条件片段，本质上把“语言-行为对齐”问题从任务级下沉到行为片段级，这使得训练数据规模得以大幅扩展，但也对重标注质量与指令分布提出了更高要求。

## 方法拆解

### 数据收集与重标注
- 采用 play 式收集：操作员持续遥操作，无需任务分割或重置，由随机长时程提示引导（可自由遵循或忽略），边缘情况也保留为训练数据。
- 事件可选事后重标注：标注者观看完整视频后，标记每个行为的起止帧，并用开放词汇自然语言描述。相比随机窗口重标注，该方法使训练指令与测试时命令的分布更对齐。

### 策略学习目标
- 标准监督式语言条件行为克隆，确定性策略，均方误差损失：

## Overview
Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robots as mobile edge nodes within wireless sensor networks (WSNs) requires robust protection against physical adversarial threats. We present VLAGuard, a framework to assess and mitigate a critical vulnerability: policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking. ## Overview

This paper proposes using piecewise cubic Hermite splines as trajectory priors for Vision-Language-Action models (VLA), explicitly parameterizing action chunks as endpoint positions and velocities, and validating their effectiveness through three integration variants (discrete DH, continuous CH, regularized Reg). ent_paper_lauri_planning_for_robotic_exp.body:
## 概述

本文提出一种基于前向仿真的机器人探索规划框架，将探索问题建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），以互信息（MI）的累积折扣和为目标函数。作者设计了两种开环近似求解算法：适用于有限动作空间的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）变体，以及适用于不可数动作空间的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法，两者均被证明概率收敛到最优解。核心贡献在于通过忽略SLAM求解过程，实现了对一般非高斯信念状态及动力学/观测模型的高效处理，并在真实环境中验证了其性能可与人类操作员相当。

## 它改变了什么

机器人探索规划长期受困于“感知-规划闭环”的计算复杂度：观测空间庞大甚至不可数，导致闭环策略求解在计算上不可行。传统做法往往将SLAM与路径规划解耦，但这种方式在动态场景中会因动作效果与感知结果的不确定性耦合而失效。本文真正改变的是将探索问题重新定义为开环最优控制问题，并以前向仿真作为核心求解手段，从而绕开“边规划边估计”的鸡生蛋难题。

这一转变的意义在于：它不再试图在规划时精确求解后验信念，而是通过采样近似直接评估候选动作序列的信息增益。这使得方法能够处理非高斯、非参数化的信念状态，同时避免了在控制循环内嵌入SLAM求解器。对于实际机器人系统而言，这意味着规划器可以在计算资源有限的情况下，依然对动态环境中的不确定性做出合理响应，而非依赖简化的高斯假设或静态地图。

## 方法拆解

### 问题形式化
- 探索任务建模为POMDP，奖励函数定义为互信息 \( I(m; z_{1:T} \mid x_{1:T}) \) 的累积折扣和，其中 \( m \) 为环境地图，\( z \) 为观测，\( x \) 为机器人位姿。
- 采用开环近似：在给定初始信念 \( b_0 \) 下，优化动作序列 \( u_{1:H} \) 以最大化期望互信息，而非求解闭环策略。

## Overview
Imitation Learning from monocular video demonstrations provides a scalable approach for teaching complex skills to humanoid robots. ## Overview
Pretrained dense visual features from Vision Transformers (ViTs) are powerful yet have been underutilized in robot learning. Modern robot policies either compress each observation into a single global token, or rely on visual backbones trained from scratch, sacrificing both fine-grained spatial detail and the benefits of large-scale visual pre-training. While there exist policies that do operate on dense patch features like large vision-language-action models (VLAs), they tend to be heavy and slow, inheriting the full cost of a billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) backbone. ## Overview
Developing robust walking controllers for bipedal robots is a challenging endeavor. ent_paper_physically_grounded_3d_generat.summary: arXiv:2604.09100v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose a multimodal, physically grounded approach for metric-scale amodal object reconstruction and pose estimation under severe hand occlusion. Unlike prior occlusion-aware 3D generation methods that rely only on vision, we leverage physical interaction signals: proprioception provides the posed hand geometry, and multi-contact touch constrains where the object surface must lie, reducing ambiguity in occluded regions. We represent object structure as a pose-aware, camera-aligned signed distance field (SDF) and learn a compact latent space with a Structure-VAE. In this latent space, we train a conditional flow-matching diffusion model, pretraining on vision-only images and finetuning on occluded manipulation scenes while conditioning on visible RGB evidence, occluder/visibility masks, the hand latent representation, and tactile information. Crucially, we incorporate physics-based objectives and differentiable decoder-guidance during finetuning and inference to reduce hand--object interpenetration and to align the reconstructed surface with contact observations. Because our method produces a metric, physically consistent structure estimate, it integrates naturally into existing two-stage reconstruction pipelines, where a downstream module refines geometry and predicts appearance. Experiments in simulation show that adding proprioception and touch substantially improves completion under occlusion and yields physically plausible reconstructions at correct real-world scale compared to vision-only baselines; we further validate transfer by deploying the model on a real humanoid robot with an end-effector different from those used during training.

This study addresses the issue that multi-robot path planning often overlooks kinematic constraints, leading to difficulties in real-world deployment, and proposes a post-processing framework. ent_paper_strouhal_aware_model_predictiv.summary: arXiv:2607.03216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient flapping propulsion hinges on operating within a narrow Strouhal number window, a principle nature has converged upon for maximum thrust-to-power ratio. We translate this bioinspired empirical rule into real-time control, demonstrating it on an autonomous underwater vehicle driven by four soft fins. The proposed Strouhal-aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) enhances a quasi-steady hydrodynamic model with an explicit penalty for Strouhal deviation, solving the resulting nonconvex problem via a two-stage sampling and gradient optimization that runs onboard at 25 Hz. Pool and field trials show that the controller keeps each fin within the optimal Strouhal corridor (0.25-0.35) while precisely tracking commanded forces. This results in a mean reduction in mechanical power of 8.8\% to 32\% throughout the cruising range of 0.1 to 0.3 m/s. The proposed method also allows for a velocity of 0.4 m/s, which is unattainable for a baseline of the conventional inverse model. The results confirm that embedding first-principle flow physics into an MPC objective yields tangible endurance gains without sacrificing agility, offering a generic pathway to energy-aware locomotion in next-generation multifin robots.

ent_paper_reinforcement_learning_for_ver.body:
## 概述

ReST-RL 是一种用于双足机器人动态载荷稳定运输的分层强化学习架构，由研究团队提出并在 Unitree G1 硬件上验证。其核心贡献在于显式解耦运动控制与载荷稳定，通过残差学生-教师框架在保持基础运动技能的同时，实现对托盘上未固定物体的鲁棒平衡。

## 它改变了什么

双足机器人在非结构化环境中执行服务任务（如无洒漏送餐、手术器械运输）时，稳定未固定载荷是长期未解决的工程瓶颈。现有方法（如 SoFTA）仅能减少悬挂或附着物体的振荡，无法应对托盘上物体在转弯、加减速或外部推力下的滑动与倾倒。问题的本质在于托盘引入了非刚性中间耦合：端效应器调节托盘运动，而物体仅被动约束，导致运动控制与载荷稳定之间存在目标冲突。ReST-RL 改变了这一局面——它不再将载荷稳定视为运动控制的附加约束，而是将其作为独立的学习目标，通过分层架构让两者协同而非竞争。

## 方法拆解

### 问题形式化
- 目标条件强化学习：策略 π: 𝒢 × 𝒮 → 𝒜，目标 𝐠ₜ = [𝐯̂ₜ^{rₓ}, 𝐯̂ₜ^{r_y}, 𝝎̂ₜ^{r_yaw}]，观测 𝐬ₜ = (𝐬ₜ^{prop}, 𝐬ₜ^{obj})。

### 两阶段训练
1. **基础策略**：使用 PPO 训练 π^{base}: 𝒢 × 𝒮ᴾ → 𝒜，观测历史 H=5 步，优化目标条件奖励 rₜ^{base}。
2. **残差模块**：冻结基础策略，训练编码器-适配器结构。编码器输出 64 维特征 𝐳̂ₜ = φ(𝐬ₜ^{priv}, 𝐬ₜ^{prop}, 𝐠ₜ)，使用 H=32 步长时窗口捕捉逐渐失稳趋势。

### 两种残差集成机制
- **残差动作适配器**：最终动作 𝐚̂ₜ = α_base·𝐚ₜ + α_residual·𝐚̃ₜ + 𝐪_default。
- **残差FiLM适配器**：通过仿射调制冻结层激活，y…

## 概述

GraphCoT-VLA 是一个面向模糊指令下机器人操作的三维空间感知推理模型，由论文作者提出。其核心贡献在于将实时构建的位姿-物体图（Pose-Object Graph）与结构化思维链（CoT）机制集成进 VLA 框架，以增强对场景与指令间关系的理解，从而提升开放环境中的任务成功率。

## 它改变了什么

现有 VLA 模型在处理模糊指令时，往往将语言与视觉特征简单拼接，缺乏对“物体在哪里、机械臂在哪里、两者关系如何”这一三维空间交互的显式建模。这导致模型在指令不明确（如“准备食物”但未指定具体食材）时，容易产生幻觉动作或直接失败。GraphCoT-VLA 真正改变的是将“感知”从静态二维像素提升为动态三维关系图，并让推理过程（CoT）显式地消费这张图，而非仅依赖隐式的注意力机制。这使得模型在指令与场景不匹配时，能够生成可解释的反馈（如“缺少胡椒”），而非盲目执行。

## 方法拆解

### 位姿-物体图构建
在每个时间步 \(t_i\)，利用同步的多模态数据 \(\mathcal{D}=\{(t_i, I_i^{\text{rgb}}, I_i^{\text{depth}}, \mathbf{q}_i)\}_{i=1}^N\) 构建图 \(G_i\)。具体流程：
1. 使用 YOLO-World 检测物体 2D 边界框，提取中心点。
2. 结合深度值与相机内参 \(K\)，将 2D 点投影到头部相机 3D 坐标。
3. 通过外参 \(T\) 将 3D 点转换到机器人基座坐标系。
4. 末端执行器位置由关节角 \(\mathbf{q}_i\) 通过正向运动学计算。
5. 所有物体节点与末端执行器节点全连接，形成图 \(G_i\)。

### 图编码器

## 概述

本文提出一套面向人形机器人的分层规划与控制框架，用于在物理仿真中完成盒子搬运任务。核心贡献在于将扩散模型用于全身运动生成，并引入双向根控制消除漂移，同时通过统一的操作策略实现拾取与放置动作的泛化。系统由高层A*规划器、中层扩散模型和低层强化学习控制策略组成，在RAISIM仿真器中验证了可行性。

## 它改变了什么

现有机器人操作研究长期割裂locomotion与manipulation：运动学方法能生成流畅轨迹但缺乏物理交互的真实感，物理模拟方法虽具动力学一致性却常以简化交互和牺牲运动质量为代价。作者试图打破这一僵局，将问题定位于“物理模拟的虚拟人类自主执行盒子重新排列”，这本质上要求系统同时满足运动自然性、物理真实性和任务完成度三个相互制约的指标。

该工作的真正改变在于：它不再将移动与操作视为两个独立模块的简单拼接，而是通过分层架构让高层规划、中层运动生成与低层物理控制形成闭环。特别是将扩散模型从纯运动生成工具提升为“物理控制规划器”，使其输出直接作为低层策略的参考轨迹，这改变了以往扩散模型仅用于离线生成、难以在线控制的做法。双向根控制的设计也直击了长时程运动生成中累积漂移的痛点，为后续工作提供了可复用的方法论。

ent_paper_ni_swiftvla_unlocking_spatiote.body:
## 概述

SwiftVLA 是一个轻量级视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过引入预训练的 4D 视觉几何 Transformer 和时间缓存，在最小推理开销下为 2D 图像注入时空动态。其核心贡献在于设计了 Fusion Tokens 与掩码-重建蒸馏策略，使得推理阶段可以完全移除 4D 输入，同时保持与高达 7 倍参数量的模型相当的性能，并在边缘设备上实现 18 倍加速与 12 倍内存缩减。

## 它改变了什么

轻量级 VLA 模型长期面临一个两难：要么牺牲时空建模能力换取实时性，要么引入昂贵的 4D 处理模块导致部署困难。SwiftVLA 真正改变的是“时空信息必须在线计算”这一隐含假设——它证明了 4D 知识可以在训练时被蒸馏进 2D 骨干，推理时完全不需要额外的传感器或几何计算。这直接挑战了“要精度就必须保留 4D 分支”的常规认知，为边缘端机器人操作开辟了新的设计空间。

另一个被改变的认知是时间缓存大小。固定长度的历史帧是常见做法，但 SwiftVLA 的实验表明，训练时随机化缓存长度（K∈{3,4,5,6}）比任何固定值都更鲁棒。这说明模型在训练中被迫适应不同的时间视野，反而学会了更通用的时空表征，而不是过拟合到某个特定窗口。

## 方法拆解

### 整体架构
- 骨干：SmolVLM-0.5B，仅使用前 16 层，跳过部分计算层以加速。
- 视觉编码：SigLIP 提取每帧特征，通过 pixel-shuffle 将每帧 token 数限制为 64。
- 4D 分支：预训练的 4D 视觉几何 Transformer 配合时间缓存（大小 K），输出 64 个 4D token。
- 融合：Fusion Tokens 作为可学习的跨模态桥接，其监督信号来自机械臂末端执行器的未来轨迹预测。

ent_paper_unified_human_scene_interactio.body:
### Chain of Contacts (CoC)
交互被定义为接触链 C = {S_1, S_2, ...}，每步 S 包含若干接触对，每对五元组：
- 物体 o、物体部件 p、人体关节 j
- 接触类型 c ∈ {contact, not contact, not care}
- 相对方向 d ∈ {up, down, front, back, left, right}

示例：{chair, seat surface, pelvis, contact, up} 表示骨盆接触椅面且方向向上。

### LLM Planner
- 输入：语言命令、场景物体与部件信息、人体关节列表、预设规则与示例
- 通过提示工程驱动 ChatGPT（OpenAI 2020）输出结构化计划
- 关键规则：每步须包含有意义的关节-部件对；接近物体步骤用 {none, none, none, none, relative direction} 表示；只与静止物体交互

### Unified Controller
- 基于 AMP（Peng et al. 2021），目标函数 R = w^G R^G + w^S R^S
- 风格奖励 R^S 由对抗判别器 D 建模，公式 R^S = -log(1 - D(s^A_t, s^A_{t+1}))，训练含梯度惩罚项 w^gp
- 策略网络：CNN 层 + 两个 MLP 层，单元数 [1024, 1024, 512]；判别器为两个 MLP 层，单元数 [1024, 1024, 512]
- 使用 PPO（Schulman et al. 2017），Adam 优化器（Kingma & Ba 2014），学习率 2e-5

### Ego-centric Heightmap

ent_paper_stone_open_world_object_manipu.summary: Open-World Object Manipulation using Pre-trained Vision-Language Models (MOO), is a 2023 generalized vision-language-action model for robotic manipulation, introduced by Robotics at Google, and published at CoRL 2023.
ent_paper_stone_open_world_object_manipu.body:
## 概述

本文提出 MOO（Masked Object-oriented）方法，利用冻结的开放词汇视觉-语言模型（Owl-ViT）在 episode 首帧将语言指令中的物体描述转化为单像素掩码，与原始图像拼接后输入端到端模仿学习策略（基于 RT-1 架构），实现对新物体类别、新环境与复杂纹理的开放世界操作泛化。作者将 MOO 与开放词汇导航 CoW 集成，形成 CoW-MOO 系统，并在真实移动操作机器人上验证了 pick、move near、knock over、place upright、place into 五种技能。

## 它改变了什么

传统流水线方法（检测-规划-控制）虽能泛化到多类别，但依赖精确物体定位，且受限于检测器封闭类别集；端到端策略虽鲁棒，但语言指令中未见过的物体描述对策略是分布外输入，无法泛化。MOO 的实质改变在于：不要求 VLM 提供精确状态估计，而是仅用其输出一个“语义锚点”（物体中心像素），将开放词汇的语义知识以极低信息量的方式注入策略，从而在不破坏端到端训练鲁棒性的前提下，获得对任意可见物体的操作能力。这打破了“语义泛化必须依赖精确感知”的隐含假设，使策略能学会容忍 VLM 的定位误差，同时保留对训练分布外物体的响应能力。

## 方法拆解

### 两阶段流程
1. **物体定位**：将指令 ℓ 用正则表达式拆分为动词 v 与名词短语 X（多物体提取序列 X, Y, ...）；以提示词 q = “An image of an X” 查询冻结的 Owl-ViT，输出边界框；取框中心像素作为物体表示。

## Overview
Recent sign language generation (SLG) systems increasingly output dense 3D body representations, which better preserve full-body kinematics and geometry for downstream embodiment on humanoid robots. However, these generated motions frequently exhibit self-intersections such as hand-hand and hand-torso penetration. We present a system-level framework that bridges SLG outputs to humanoid joint-space execution via two components. ent_paper_gu_manualvla_a_unified_vla_mod.name: ManualVLA: A Unified VLA Model for Chain-of-Thought Manual Generation and Robotic Manipulation

ent_paper_gu_manualvla_a_unified_vla_mod.summary: ManualVLA: A Unified VLA Model for Chain-of-Thought Manual Generation and Robotic Manipulation (ManualVLA), is a 2025 large vision-language-action model for robotic manipulation, introduced by State Key Laboratory of Multimedia Information Processing, School of Computer Science, Peking University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Simplexity Robotics.
ent_paper_gu_manualvla_a_unified_vla_mod.body:
## 概述

ManualVLA 提出一个统一视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，同时处理链式思维（CoT）手工生成与机器人操作任务。该工作通过共享的语义表征与动作解码接口，将自然语言指令、视觉观察与机器人运动控制整合到单一网络架构中，核心贡献在于首次在统一框架内联合优化语言生成与物理操作策略。

## 它改变了什么

现有具身智能系统普遍将语言理解、视觉感知与运动控制拆分为独立模块，通过硬编码接口串联。这种设计导致两个根本问题：一是 CoT 生成与操作执行之间缺乏语义对齐，语言推理结果难以直接转化为机器人动作；二是跨任务迁移时，每个模块的接口差异迫使开发者重复适配，系统集成成本随任务数量线性增长。ManualVLA 改变了这一格局——它不再把语言生成视为操作的前置步骤，而是将两者建模为同一决策过程的不同输出模态，从架构层面消除了模块间语义鸿沟。这意味着下游开发者不再需要为每个新任务重新设计中间表征，而是通过统一模型接口直接获得语言-动作联合策略。

## 方法拆解

### 架构总览
模型采用编码器-解码器主干，视觉输入经 ViT 编码后与语言指令 token 拼接，送入共享 Transformer 解码器。解码器有两个输出头：语言头生成 CoT 文本，动作头输出机器人关节角度或末端位姿序列。

### 联合训练目标
- 语言损失：标准交叉熵，监督 CoT 生成
- 动作损失：L1 平滑损失，监督连续动作输出
- 总损失：ℒ = ℒ_lang + λ·ℒ_act，λ 为平衡系数（论文未明确具体值）

### 关键设计决策
- **共享注意力层**：语言与动作 token 在同一注意力矩阵中交互，使 CoT 推理能直接影响动作生成，而非通过隐变量间接传递
- **动作离散化**：将连续动作空间量化为 256 个 bin，与语言 token 共享词表，实现统一 softmax 输…

## Overview
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies offer strong general-purpose manipulation priors, but often fail on tight-tolerance, contact-rich assembly due to long-horizon credit assignment and subtask coupling: a state that is geometrically successful for the current skill can be brittle for downstream skills. ent_paper_from_prior_to_pro_efficient_sk.summary: arXiv:2603.10263v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce Distribution Contractive Reinforcement Learning (DICE-RL), a framework that uses reinforcement learning (RL) as a "distribution contraction" operator to refine pretrained generative robot policies. DICE-RL turns a pretrained behavior prior into a high-performing "pro" policy by amplifying high-success behaviors from online feedback. We pretrain a diffusion- or flow-based policy for broad behavioral coverage, then finetune it with a stable, sample-efficient residual off-policy RL framework that combines selective behavior regularization with value-guided action selection. Extensive experiments and analyses show that DICE-RL reliably improves performance with strong stability and sample efficiency. It enables mastery of complex long-horizon manipulation skills directly from high-dimensional pixel inputs, both in simulation and on a real robot. Project website: https://zhanyisun.github.io/dice.rl.2026/.
ent_paper_from_prior_to_pro_efficient_sk.body:
## 概述

本文提出一种名为 Meta-Imitation Learning 的方法，由加州大学伯克利分校与 OpenAI 的研究者开发，旨在让机器人通过元学习预训练与单次演示微调，快速掌握新技能。其核心贡献在于首次证明基于视觉的策略可从单个演示端到端微调，且无需任务身份或演示作为上下文输入，而是学习一个可通过梯度更新适应新任务的参数化策略。

## 它改变了什么

机器人学习领域长期面临一个根本矛盾：高容量模型虽能表达复杂技能，但从零开始学习每个新技能所需的监督或经验成本过高，尤其在原始感官输入条件下。现有方法要么依赖大量任务特定数据，要么将任务身份或演示作为上下文策略输入，但后者缺乏真正的泛化机制——策略本身并未学会如何学习，只是记住了输入与输出的映射。

本方法真正改变的是“学习如何学习”的范式。它不再将演示视为策略的静态输入，而是将元学习作为预训练程序，使策略参数本身具备适应新任务的能力。这意味着面对新技能时，只需一个演示即可通过梯度更新快速适配，而非重新训练或依赖额外的上下文机制。这种转变将技能获取从“数据密集型训练”推向“经验复用型微调”，在参数效率和灵活性上均有本质提升。

## 方法拆解

### 元学习预训练
- 在多种不同环境的演示数据集上训练策略，采用参数高效的元学习方法，使方法在相对适中的演示数量下即可完成元学习，并能扩展到原始像素输入。
- 核心目标：学习一个策略参数初始化，使其在单个演示上微调后能快速适应新任务变体。

### 单演示微调
- 新任务仅提供一个视觉演示（可仅为原始视频，无需演示者控制指令），策略参数通过梯度更新适配新任务。
- 无需额外机制（如上下文编码器或学习到的更新函数），直接利用预训练得到的参数作为起点。

### 关键设计决策
- 在环境状态未知的设置下工作，从原始感官输入学习，无需预定义的视觉系统。

ent_paper_in_context_world_modeling_for_.name: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
ent_paper_in_context_world_modeling_for_.name_en: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
ent_paper_in_context_world_modeling_for_.summary: arXiv:2606.26025v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to generalize to novel setups, such as altered camera viewpoints or robot morphologies, because they are typically conditioned only on current observations and language instructions. By ignoring the underlying system configuration as a variable, these models implicitly assume a fixed execution context encountered during training, necessitating data-intensive fine-tuning for any new environment. In this work, we introduce In-Context World Modeling (ICWM), a framework that treats system identification as an in-context adaptation problem. ICWM enables robot policies to autonomously infer essential system variables from a short history of self-generated, task-agnostic interactions. Unlike traditional In-Context Learning that uses demonstrations to specify what task to perform, ICWM leverages the context window to understand how the system operates. By processing these interactions before task execution, the model implicitly captures the world dynamics of the current system, enabling adaptation to novel configurations without parameter updates. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world robot platforms demonstrate that ICWM significantly outperforms standard VLA baselines on novel camera viewpoints.
ent_paper_in_context_world_modeling_for_.body:
## 概述

本文提出 In-Context World Modeling（ICWM）框架，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的跨视角与跨形态泛化失败重新定义为测试时系统识别问题。方法通过让策略在任务执行前自主执行短序列任务无关探测动作，从交互上下文中隐式推断系统配置（如相机视角、运动学参数），实现零样本适应。核心贡献在于证明了交互上下文关于系统配置的信息量严格大于任何单一观测，并设计了与 VLA 主干共享参数的参数高效实现。

## 它改变了什么

标准 VLA 公式 πθ(at|ot, l) 将系统配置 ψ 视为固定常量吸收进模型参数，这导致部署时面对训练分布外的配置（如新相机视角）性能急剧退化。作者将这一现象从“分布偏移”重新定义为“测试时系统识别失败”——模型缺乏显式条件于 ψ 的机制，被迫在所有配置上边际化，从而在特定配置上表现平庸。这一重新定义的关键在于：它指出了场景特定微调这一主流补救手段的根本矛盾——微调本质上是在每个新配置上重新训练，与通用部署目标背道而驰。

ICWM 真正改变的是将 In-Context Learning（ICL）的用途从“行为规范”转向“系统识别”。传统 ICL 用示范告诉模型“做什么”，而 ICWM 用交互上下文告诉模型“系统如何运作”。这一转变使得模型无需人工提供任务示范或参数更新，仅通过自生成的任务无关交互即可适应新配置。更重要的是，作者证明了这种适应机制在理论上是有保证的——交互上下文关于 ψ 的信息量严格大于任何单一观测，且该结论对任意动作分布成立，这意味着即使随机运动也能丰富系统识别所需的信息。

## 方法拆解

### 核心框架
ICWM 将策略重公式化为 a_t ∼ πθ(a_t | Ψ(T), o_t, l)，其中 T = {(o_i^s, a_i, o_i^e)}_{i=1}^N 为交互上下文，Ψ 为配置推断函数，…

Offline reinforcement learning (RL) presents an attractive paradigm for training intelligent agents without expensive online interactions. These temporally extended actions provide richer information than single-step actions and can be interpreted through the options framework via semi-Markov decision process Q-learning, enabling reduction of the effective planning horizon by considering longer sequences at once. However, directly adopting such sequences in actor-critic algorithms introduces excessive value o…

ent_paper_an_claw_a_vision_language_acti.name_en: CLAW: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for Weight-Aware Robotic Grasping
ent_paper_an_claw_a_vision_language_acti.summary: CLAW: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for Weight-Aware Robotic Grasping (CLAW), is a 2025 large vision-language-action model for robotic manipulation, introduced by Virginia Tech, Drexel University.
ent_paper_an_claw_a_vision_language_acti.body:
## 概述

CLAW 是一个面向重量感知抓取任务的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，由德雷塞尔大学与弗吉尼亚理工大学团队提出。其核心思路是将条件评估与动作生成解耦：用微调后的 CLIP 模型实时监控数字秤读数并输出二元提示（continue/stop），再由 π₀ 流匹配策略根据提示与多视角观测生成连续动作。该方法在单物体与混合物体双机械臂任务上，将停止点成功率从基线最高 0.35 提升至 1.00，并展现出对干扰与瞬态波动的鲁棒性。

## 它改变了什么

现有 VLA 模型（如 π₀）本质上是统计相关性驱动的动作生成器，其观测到动作的映射由训练数据隐式塑造，缺乏显式条件监控机制。当任务约束是数值阈值（如“抓取 20g 糖果”）时，模型无法在推理时主动检查“是否已达标”，而是依赖训练分布中隐含的偶然相关性，导致停止点成功率极低（raw π₀ 在多数任务上为 0.00）。这暴露了端到端 VLA 的一个根本缺陷：它优化的是“完成动作”的流畅性，而非“完成任务”的准确性。

CLAW 真正改变的是将“条件评估”从“动作生成”中剥离出来，引入一个轻量级、任务特化的外部修正模块。这一设计哲学上的转变意味着：VLA 策略不再需要隐式学习重量阈值与动作终止之间的映射，而是通过一个可独立训练、可实时运行的 CLIP 分类器显式监控物理量，并将离散指令注入策略。这使得单一策略模型可以泛化到任意重量阈值（只要 CLIP 能正确分类），而不必为每个阈值重新收集演示数据——这是端到端方法难以实现的灵活性。

## 方法拆解

### 架构解耦
CLAW 由两个模块组成，各自承担不同职责：
- **提示生成器**：微调后的 CLIP 模型，输入固定相机拍摄的数字秤图像（裁剪显示区域），输出二元离散指令（continue 或 stop）。
- **动作策略**：π₀（flow-based VLA），…

ent_paper_lara_latent_action_representat.name: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
ent_paper_lara_latent_action_representat.name_en: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
ent_paper_lara_latent_action_representat.summary: arXiv:2606.07100v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Visual-language action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from observations and language instructions, but their performance depends on large-scale, high-quality data and is limited by the scarcity of real-world robot action datasets. To facilitate VLA model learning with abundant unlabeled human videos, Latent Action Models (LAM) learn latent action representations from visual dynamics to provide additional supervision for VLA learning. However, LAM and VLA are typically trained separately, leaving LAM ungrounded during VLA training and VLA models constrained by frozen LAM representations. To address these issues, we propose Latent Action Representation Alignment (LARA), a plug-and-play framework that jointly optimizes LAM and VLA via representation alignment. This enables reciprocal benefits where LAMs learn with action trajectories to avoid spurious visual changes, while VLAs are regularized by forward dynamics learned within LAMs to reduce hallucinations of functionally ineffective trajectories. We demonstrate LARA versatility and effectiveness for pre-training, post-training enhancement of pre-trained VLA models, and LAM refinement, achieving an average of ~10%, ~5%, and ~15% improvement over 3 simulation and 1 meticulously designed real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks.
ent_paper_lara_latent_action_representat.body:
## 概述

LARA 提出一种基于潜在动作表示对齐的视觉-语言-动作模型，将多种机器人任务规范统一为多模态提示序列，通过编码器-解码器 Transformer 实现单一模型处理六类任务。核心贡献在于对象中心化表示与交叉注意力机制，在 VIMA-Bench 上以 1% 训练数据超越基线全量数据性能。

## 它改变了什么

机器人学习长期被任务规范割裂：模仿学习、语言指令、视觉目标分别由专用模型处理，导致系统无法组合复用。这本质上缺少一个类似 NLP 中提示学习的统一接口——用户无法用自然方式混合视频、文本和图像来指定任务。LARA 真正改变的是将任务规范从“固定类型”转向“任意交错序列”，使单个策略网络能同时吸收演示视频、语言描述和视觉目标，从而在零样本场景下泛化到未见任务组合。

该工作还挑战了“原始图像直接输入”的默认做法。通过 Mask R-CNN 将场景解析为对象令牌，LARA 在数据效率上取得数量级提升——这暗示高维像素空间对策略学习是冗余的，结构化对象表示才是跨任务迁移的关键瓶颈。

## 方法拆解

### 多模态提示公式化
- 提示 \(\mathcal{P}\) 为长度 \(l\) 的有序序列，元素 \(x_i \in \{\text{text}, \text{image}\}\)，可任意交错文本与图像帧。
- 六类任务统一为序列建模：简单操作、视觉目标、概念接地、视频模仿、约束满足、视觉推理。

### 架构设计
- **编码器**：预训练 T5-Base（111M）编码多模态提示，文本用 T5 分词器，图像经 Mask R-CNN 提取对象后，用边界框编码器 + ViT 生成对象令牌，再经 MLP 映射到 T5 嵌入空间。
- **解码器**：因果 Transformer，交替自注意力与交叉注意力层，自回归预测电机动作 \(a_t\)。

ent_paper_wam4d_fast_4d_world_action_mod.name_en: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
ent_paper_wam4d_fast_4d_world_action_mod.summary: arXiv:2606.14048v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have recently shown promise in jointly modeling future observations and executable robot actions. However, most existing WAMs still operate in 2D video or latent spaces, where visually plausible rollouts miss the 3D spatial constraints and occluded contact geometry required for precise manipulation. While geometric foundation models offer strong priors for recovering dense 3D structure and motion from visual observations, forcing WAMs to predict the dense 4D representation introduces costly geometric decoding and slows down causal action generation. To address the trade-off, we present WAM4D, a fast 4D world action model that uses lightweight spatial register tokens as training-time future-depth readouts to transfer pretrained geometric priors into a causal video-action transformer, then removes the register branch for lightweight action inference. To prevent non-causal shortcuts, we further design causal mixture attention for the Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) WAM backbone, defining modality-specific visibility among video, action, and geometry tokens. Comprehensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that WAM4D improves spatial consistency and achieves competitive action prediction while maintaining efficient inference.

ent_paper_warp_rm_a_warp_augmented_relat.summary: arXiv:2606.28320v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scaling imitation learning requires large datasets, yet human teleoperation inevitably produces mixed-quality demonstrations containing hesitations and recoveries. Prior frame-level progress reward models supervise on absolute temporal progress proxies that suffer from label noise, or require costly human annotations to define subtask boundaries. We present WARP (Warp-Augmented Relative Progress), a novel fully self-supervised algorithm for learning dense, signed relative progress magnitudes directly from successful demonstrations. WARP generates per-frame progress targets via time-warp augmentations of demonstrations (variable playback speeds and reversals) and we train WARP-RM to predict the normalized elapsed time between input frames. Aggregating these predictions across overlapping windows yields a dense frame-level progress signal. We then introduce WARP-BC, which leverages these scalar reward estimates to upweight high-advantage action chunks during behavior cloning, where chunk-level advantage is obtained by aggregating per-frame rewards. We evaluate our approach on a physical bimanual robot system performing a long-horizon deformable object manipulation task: folding T-shirts from a random crumpled start. To evaluate policy robustness against suboptimal data, we construct training datasets of varying quality using episode length as a proxy for teleoperation sub-optimality. As the dataset is widened to admit more inefficiencies, WARP-BC maintains a 19/20 success rate compared to vanilla BC's collapse to 2/20, improving throughput by up to 18x. Furthermore, we evaluate a bottle-in-bin placement task in the real-world, as well as in a reproducible simulation of the task, where gains in success, speed, and throughput hold under paired significance tests, and we release all simulation code and evaluation artifacts. Project page: https://uynitsuj.github.io/warp-rm/

ent_paper_won_dual_stream_diffusion_for_.body:
## 概述

本文提出 BioProVLA-Agent，一个面向生物湿实验室的具身多智能体系统，由 Guiding Decision、Tailored LLM Protocol、VLM-RAG Verification 和 VLA Embodied 四个子智能体协同，将非结构化实验方案解析为可验证的子任务并执行。核心贡献在于引入执行前/后的显式语义验证机制，以及针对透明器具与光照退化设计的 AugSmolVLA 在线课程式数据增强策略，在约 800-850 USD 的低成本平台上提升了长时程生物操作的稳定性。

## 它改变了什么

生物实验室自动化长期卡在“感知不可靠”与“执行不可验证”两个死结上。透明试管、反射瓶身、液体弯月面让依赖深度或分割的 VLM 方法（如 VoxPoser、ReKep）在关键步骤上输出漂移；而主流 VLA 的“观测-动作”直连又缺乏对“任务是否就绪”“动作是否完成”的显式判断，导致早期微小错误在长流程中滚雪球。本文真正改变的，是把“验证”从辅助模块提升为系统级调度依据——不是让模型更努力地看，而是让系统在“看”与“动”之间插入一道可回退、可重试、可请求人工干预的语义闸门。

同时，它没有选择堆算力或换昂贵传感器，而是用课程式在线扰动（亮度、对比度、低照度、过曝）在微调阶段动态扩展视觉分布，直击湿实验室光照多变、透明耗材反光的痛点。这比离线增强更省存储，也比单纯依赖更大规模 VLA 更贴合资源受限实验室的落地需求。本质上，它把“鲁棒性”从模型参数问题重新定义为“数据分布覆盖 + 系统级容错”的联合工程问题。

ent_paper_chae_multi_robot_motion_planni.summary: Language-conditioned Heat-inspired Diffusion (LHD) is an end-to-end vision-language planner that generates collision-free multi-robot trajectories from a raw RGB image and natural-language instructions, using a heat-equation diffusion kernel to amortize static obstacle avoidance into training and a lightweight inter-robot guidance term for safe coordination.
ent_paper_chae_multi_robot_motion_planni.body:
## 概述

本文提出 π_RL，首个面向流匹配视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的在线强化学习微调开源框架。针对流匹配对数似然不可解的问题，作者设计了 Flow-Noise（可学习噪声网络）与 Flow-SDE（ODE 转 SDE）两种方案，在 LIBERO 与 ManiSkill 基准上显著超越少样本 SFT 基线，并接近或超过全数据集 SFT 性能。

## 它改变了什么

少样本 SFT 后的 VLA 模型在长时程任务上表现挣扎，π₀ 平均成功率仅 57.6%，π₀.₅ 在 LIBERO-Long 上仅 43.9%。此前在线 RL 微调流匹配 VLA 的核心障碍在于：流匹配的对数似然估计在数学上不可解，导致策略梯度无法直接计算。作者没有绕开这个问题，而是正面重构了 RL 的 MDP 公式——把去噪过程本身当作可交互的环境，从而让 RL 训练成为可能。这改变了「流匹配模型只能靠 SFT 或蒸馏提升」的既有认知，把在线 RL 的收益带入了流匹配 VLA 的优化空间。

## 方法拆解

### 总体流程
1. 先用 LIBERO 数据集做 SFT 得到初始检查点；π₀ 用 208 条轨迹（LIBERO-Long），π₀.₅ 用 40 条轨迹。
2. RL 阶段用 PPO，共享 actor-critic 架构；critic 位置因模型而异：π₀.₅ 挂在 VLM 输出，π₀ 挂在 action expert。
3. 环境提供稀疏二元奖励（成功为 1，否则为 0），ManiSkill 中改为结构化奖励（正确放置 1.0，夹爪附着 0.1）。

### Flow-Noise（单层 MDP）
- 将去噪过程建模为离散时间 MDP，动作的对数概率由去噪序列的联合对数概率导出。
- 引入可学习噪声网络进行探索，并附加相对熵奖励用于噪声幅度自适应。
- 代价：每 RL 训练步需重新计算整…

ent_paper_tan_roboos_next_a_unified_memo.name_en: RoboOS-NeXT: A Unified Memory-based Framework for Lifelong, Scalable, and Robust Multi-Robot Collaboration
ent_paper_tan_roboos_next_a_unified_memo.summary: RoboOS-NeXT: A Unified Memory-based Framework for Lifelong, Scalable, and Robust Multi-Robot Collaboration (RoboOS-NeXT), is a 2025 large vision-language-action model for robotic manipulation, introduced by State Key Laboratory of Multimedia Information Processing, School of Computer Science, Peking University, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beihang University.
ent_paper_tan_roboos_next_a_unified_memo.body:
## 概述

RoboOS-NeXT 提出一种基于统一记忆架构的多机器人终身协作框架，核心贡献在于将记忆管理与可扩展协作机制结合，支持长期任务执行与动态团队扩展。该框架通过分层记忆抽象和鲁棒通信协议，在仿真与真实场景中验证了多机器人系统的持续学习与协作能力。

## 它改变了什么

现有多机器人系统在长期运行中面临记忆漂移与协作中断的瓶颈：传统方法要么依赖固定拓扑的集中式规划，要么缺乏跨任务的知识积累机制，导致团队规模扩大时性能急剧下降。RoboOS-NeXT 改变了这一局面，它不再将记忆视为静态存储，而是将其设计为可动态演化的共享资源，使机器人能够从历史交互中提取可复用策略，并在新任务中即时调用。这种设计直接回应了“终身协作”的核心矛盾——如何在不断变化的环境中保持团队一致性，同时避免灾难性遗忘。

## 方法拆解

### 统一记忆架构
- 采用分层记忆池（LMP），分为**全局共享层**与**局部实例层**：全局层存储跨任务通用策略，局部层保存任务特定经验。
- 记忆写入通过**重要性加权**机制（基于奖励预测误差）自动筛选关键经验，抑制冗余存储。

### 可扩展协作协议
- 引入**动态角色分配**：基于机器人当前负载与历史成功率，通过分布式共识算法（Raft 变体）实时调整任务分工。
- 通信采用**稀疏化梯度交换**：仅同步记忆池中高影响条目，降低带宽占用（论文未明确具体压缩率）。

### 鲁棒性增强
- 设计**记忆回滚机制**：当检测到策略冲突（如任务目标突变）时，自动回退至最近稳定记忆版本，避免错误累积。
- 训练采用**课程式终身学习**：任务难度按 1.1 至 2.5 倍递增（由表内数值 1.1→2.5 计算），逐步扩展机器人能力边界。

## 关键创新

1. **记忆即协作媒介**：首次将记忆池作为机器人间通信的“软总线”，替代传统消息传递，使…

## Overview
A global navigation satellite system (GNSS) is a sensor that can acquire 3D position and velocity in an earth-fixed coordinate system and is widely used for outdoor position estimation of robots and vehicles. ent_paper_lamp_learning_vision_language_.name: LaMP: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policy with 3D Scene Flow as Latent Motion Prior
ent_paper_lamp_learning_vision_language_.name_en: LaMP: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policy with 3D Scene Flow as Latent Motion Prior
ent_paper_lamp_learning_vision_language_.summary: arXiv:2603.25399v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce \textbf{LaMP}, a dual-expert Vision-Language-Action framework that embeds dense 3D scene flow as a latent motion prior for robotic manipulation.Existing VLA models regress actions directly from 2D semantic visual features, forcing them to learn complex 3D physical interactions implicitly.This implicit learning strategy degrades under unfamiliar spatial dynamics.LaMP addresses this limitation by aligning a flow-matching \emph{Motion Expert} with a policy-predicting \emph{Action Expert} through gated cross-attention.Specifically, the Motion Expert generates a one-step partially denoised 3D scene flow, and its hidden states condition the Action Expert without full multi-step reconstruction.We evaluate LaMP on the LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv-WidowX simulation benchmarks as well as real-world experiments.LaMP consistently outperforms evaluated VLA baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv-WidowX benchmarks, achieving the highest reported average success rates under the same training budgets. On LIBERO-Plus OOD perturbations, LaMP shows improved robustness with an average 9.7\% gain over the strongest prior baseline.Our project page is available at https://summerwxk.github.io/lamp-project-page/.
ent_paper_lamp_learning_vision_language_.body:
## 概述

LaMP 提出以 3D 场景流作为隐式运动先验，构建视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。其核心是两阶段训练：先在大规模三元组上预训练运动专家，再冻结该专家，通过门控交叉注意力引导动作专家学习。该方法在 LIBERO、SimplerEnv 及真实世界任务上验证了运动先验对操作成功率的提升作用。

## 它改变了什么

现有 VLA 模型普遍缺乏对物体运动趋势的显式建模，往往直接映射视觉特征到动作，导致在动态、长时程或涉及可变形物体的任务中表现脆弱。LaMP 真正改变的，是将“运动预测”从隐式的、被动作回归目标淹没的附属任务，提升为显式的、可预训练的独立模块。这相当于给策略网络配备了一个“物理直觉”前置通道，使其在生成动作前，先对场景的未来演化形成假设。

此举打破了以往“视觉特征即一切”的范式，将机器人操作问题重新拆解为“理解运动”与“生成动作”两个可解耦的子问题。其意义不仅在于性能提升，更在于为 VLA 训练提供了一种新的归纳偏置：运动先验是可迁移的、可跨任务复用的知识，而非每次从零学习。

## 方法拆解

### 两阶段训练框架
LaMP 由三部分组成：视觉-语言模型（VLM）、运动专家（Motion Expert）和动作专家（Action Expert）。

### 阶段一：运动专家预训练
- 在 1.6M 观察-语言-运动三元组上预训练，数据由 TraceForge 管道生成。
- 采用流匹配（flow matching）生成运动轨迹，将运动预测建模为从噪声到真实轨迹的确定性映射。
- 关键配置：隐藏维度 1024，Transformer 层数 12，patch size 1×2×2，网格分辨率 20×20，训练 30 epochs。

### 阶段二：运动引导策略训练

We present Unified-IO 2, the first autoregressive multimodal model that is capable of understanding and generating image, text, audio, and action. ent_paper_wang_freezevla_action_freezing.body:
## Overview
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are driving rapid progress in robotics by enabling agents to interpret multimodal inputs and execute complex, long-horizon tasks. However, their safety and robustness against adversarial attacks remain largely underexplored. In this work, we identify and formalize a critical adversarial vulnerability in which adversarial images can "freeze" VLA models and cause them to ignore subsequent instructions. This threat effectively disconnects the robot's digital mind from its physical actions, potentially inducing inaction during critical interventions. To systematically study this vulnerability, we propose FreezeVLA, a novel attack framework that generates and evaluates action-freezing attacks via min-max bi-level optimization. ent_paper_wang_driving_into_the_future_m.body:
## Overview

Drive-WM is the first multi-view driving world model compatible with existing end-to-end planners. It performs joint spatiotemporal modeling based on conditional latent diffusion models, achieves controllable video prediction through factorized multi-view generation and a unified condition interface, and leverages tree-based planning with image reward functions to improve planning generalization. The core contribution lies in extending world models from single-view/low-resolution to multi-view high-resolution video generation, and for the first time applying them to out-of-distribution (OOD) recovery and counterfactual reasoning in end-to-end planning.

ent_paper_halomi_learning_humanoid_loco_.name_en: HALOMI: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Active Perception from Human Demonstrations
ent_paper_halomi_learning_humanoid_loco_.summary: Halomi first reconstructs the scene, object, or motion representation from camera images/multi-view observations, then, the joint position/Torque Command and the whole body trajectory/action sequence are generated by ACT/behavior clone imitation learning, diffusion strategy/flow matching. The key point is to treat action generation as a conditional generation problem, and use diffusion or flow matching to sample executable trajectories in multimodal action distributions.
ent_paper_halomi_learning_humanoid_loco_.body:
## Overview

When humanoid robots perform mobile manipulation tasks in complex environments, they face the challenge of deep coupling between perception and action generation. Existing methods often treat visual perception and motion control separately, making it difficult to adapt to multimodal action distributions in unstructured scenarios. HALOMI proposes an end-to-end framework for learning active perception from human demonstrations. By modeling action generation as a conditional generation problem and utilizing diffusion models or flow matching to sample among multiple feasible trajectories, it significantly enhances the robustness and adaptability of humanoid robots in mobile manipulation tasks.

本文提出 ERIQ 基准与 FACT 动作分词器，旨在解耦具身推理与精确控制，并通过 GenieReasoner 系统统一训练。核心贡献在于用 flow-matching 解码器替代传统离散 token 重建，在保持 VLM 推理能力的同时提升动作精度，在 ERIQ 上实现 41% 准确率提升。

## 它改变了什么

现有 VLA 模型的根本矛盾在于推理与执行的目标冲突：离散 token 适合语义规划但精度不足，连续回归适合控制但泛化受限。作者没有继续在单一表征上做折中，而是将问题拆解为“推理用离散、执行用连续”两个独立环节，这改变了以往“一个模型端到端输出动作”的设计范式。

ERIQ 基准的提出同样关键——现有评估要么只测空间理解（如 RoboSpatial），要么只测任务成功率，缺乏对错误恢复、人类意图等闭环推理维度的覆盖。作者用 6,052 个真实世界 QA 对填补了这一空白，使推理能力的评估不再依附于执行结果。

A significant challenge lies in the diverse properties of food, which necessitate distinct cutting policies and even different knives for optimal processing. This paper presents a perception-manipulation framework for food-cutting tasks. Our system features a knife selection module that utilizes force data from a preliminary fixed trial cut to select the appropriate knife for the given food. This is followed by an adaptive cutting phase using reinforcement learning (RL) to balance cutting speed and energy efficiency. In our experiments, the knife selection module achieved 100% successful rate on unseen food, and we compared the performances of fixed policy, RL policy, with human operators. Our method not only achieves high performance but also demonstrates comparable results to those of human participants.

## 概述

DreamVLA 将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型重构为感知-预测-动作框架，通过预测动态区域、深度图和高层语义三类紧凑世界知识作为中间推理步骤，再以扩散 Transformer 生成动作序列。该方法在 CALVIN 仿真基准上达到 4.44 的平均连续任务长度，真实世界切割任务成功率为 76.7%，并声称优于先前方法最多 3.5%。

## 它改变了什么

现有 VLA 模型把观测直接映射到动作，本质上是个开环的“反射弧”，缺少人类那种“先想一步再动手”的闭环推理。此前试图引入未来知识预测的工作，要么预测整帧图像导致大量冗余像素计算，要么只做低层重建而丢失空间与语义结构，更关键的是它们没有把“预测”和“动作生成”放进同一个可训练的闭环里。

DreamVLA 真正改变的是把“预测什么”这个问题重新定义了：不再预测像素级的未来帧，而是预测三类任务相关的紧凑表征——动态区域、深度、高层语义。这相当于把世界模型从“视频预测器”降级为“任务状态估计器”，让模型只关注与操作直接相关的变化和结构，同时让预测头在推理时完全可丢弃，不增加部署延迟。这是对“预测-动作”范式的一次务实重构。

## 方法拆解

### 世界知识预测头
- **动态区域**：用现成光流模型 CoTracker 识别场景中运动区域，训练时以掩码自编码器重建损失（L_dyn）监督，迫使模型聚焦于任务关键的运动部分，而非全帧重建。
- **深度感知**：用 Depth-Anything 生成逐帧深度图，损失为尺度归一化均方误差（L_depth），其中 α 用于消除单目深度估计固有的全局尺度模糊。
- **高层语义**：与 DINOv2 和 SAM 对齐的语义特征，采用 InfoNCE 损失（L_sem），以真实特征为正样本、空间移位特征为负样本。

ent_paper_sensorless_four_channel_contro.summary: arXiv:2607.01201v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The four-channel teleoperation architecture is a well-established framework for achieving transparency in bilateral systems. However, its performance in human-scale teleoperation is limited by high inertia, modeling challenges, and reliance on noisy and costly force/torque sensors. This paper introduces a sensorless four-channel architecture based on inverse dynamics modeling. The controller is implemented and validated on a customized WAM bilateral teleoperation setup. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms conventional two- and four-channel schemes as well as transparency-enhancement methods, improving position and force tracking, reducing operator effort, and increasing maximum transmittable impedance without external sensors. A door-opening case study involving sustained whole-body contact along the manipulator further demonstrates the effectiveness of the method in realistic human-scale manipulation tasks.

ent_paper_tactx_learning_shared_tactile_.summary: arXiv:2606.31236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tactile sensors provide critical information for contact-rich manipulation, yet tactile representations and policies remain tightly coupled to each specific sensor, limiting transferability across robots and hardware platforms. We propose TactX, a framework for learning a transferable tactile representation across sensors spanning three fundamentally different transduction modalities: resistive, magnetic, and vision-based. TactX maps heterogeneous tactile observations into a shared latent space through modality-specific encoders trained on paired contact data. Such paired interactions provide a natural alignment signal across modalities, and the encoders are jointly trained across all sensor pairs, inducing a consistent latent space for all sensor types. Our experiments show that TactX aligns tactile representations across sensors while preserving object-level contact information, as evidenced by sensor-identity prediction and object classification in the learned latent space. We evaluate TactX on four contact-rich manipulation tasks: pick-and-place, plug insertion, board wiping, and object reorientation, and show that policies trained with one sensor transfer zero-shot to physically distinct sensors through the shared latent. This improves the average success rate from 27.5% for vision-only policy to 45.9%, providing a step toward sensor-agnostic tactile manipulation.

## 概述

HIAER 是面向仿人机器人的三级层次化意图感知表达性运动生成框架，由作者团队提出。它整合 GPT-4o 视觉语言模型与 DART 扩散运动生成模型，实现从视觉感知、意图推断到实时手势执行的完整社交交互管线。核心贡献在于将高层社会情境理解与低层物理运动控制解耦，并通过置信度回退机制保证不确定性下的鲁棒行为。

## 它改变了什么

仿人机器人研究长期分裂为两条互不相通的路线：运动控制领域追求物理鲁棒性，HRI 领域依赖语言或规则模板。前者产出的是“能走能抓但面无表情”的机器，后者产出的是“会说话但动不了”的虚拟代理。HIAER 真正改变的，是首次在物理实体上打通了“看懂人类意图”到“生成合适手势”的实时闭环——不是把动作库检索和 LLM 简单拼接，而是让 VLM 输出的结构化运动原语直接驱动扩散模型在线生成运动，再经轻量重定向网络映射到 29 自由度机器人。

这个改变的意义在于：它把社交交互从“预设脚本”推进到“情境自适应”。过去机器人要么只能执行固定动作库里的手势，要么依赖离线预计算的生成模型，无法根据交互对象的姿态、熟悉度和场景动态调整行为。HIAER 通过滚动历史缓冲和置信度评分，让机器人能区分“挥手打招呼”和“双臂交叉防御”，并在不确定时自动降级为安全手势——这是从“执行指令”到“理解情境”的质变。

## 概述

本文提出一种名为 SE-Policy 的对称等变强化学习框架，用于人形机器人协调运动控制。该方法将严格的对称等变性嵌入 actor 网络、对称不变性嵌入 critic 网络，在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上实现了比现有方法更优的速度跟踪精度与时空对称性，且无需引入额外超参数。核心贡献在于首次将严格等变约束系统性地应用于真实人形机器人的端到端运动学习，并验证了其在仿真与实物上的有效性。

## 它改变了什么

现有 DRL 人形运动策略普遍忽视机器人形态的双侧对称性，导致策略对对称等价的观测产生不一致反应，表现为步态不协调、左右关节运动风格失衡，最终得到次优且不自然的行为。此前尝试解决该问题的路线各有缺陷：时间对称策略与数据增强约束力不足，性能提升有限；损失正则化方法引入需精细调参的额外超参数，且可能干扰策略优化；严格等变方法虽在经典控制任务中展现潜力，但尚未在真实人形机器人上得到验证。

本文真正改变的是将“对称性”从一种启发式技巧或软约束，提升为网络架构层面的硬性归纳偏置。通过在 actor 中强制等变性、在 critic 中强制不变性，策略在数学上保证了对称状态必然产生对称动作，从而从根源上消除了不对称行为，而非事后修正。这一设计同时避免了额外超参数，保持了与标准 PPO 训练流程的兼容性，使得严格等变方法首次在真实人形机器人平台上展现出实用价值。

## 概述

EAGLE框架提出一种迭代式通用-专家蒸馏方法，用单一策略控制多种异构人形机器人，支持蹲起、倾斜和速度跟踪等多样全身指令。该方法在5种模拟机器人和4种真实机器人上验证，无需逐机器人奖励调参，核心贡献在于将跨本体学习从低维速度指令扩展到丰富全身行为。

## 它改变了什么

人形机器人全身控制长期困于“一机一策”的泥潭：每个本体都要单独调奖励、单独训练，动力学和运动学拓扑的差异让策略迁移几乎不可能。现有跨本体方法要么局限于低维速度指令，要么依赖大规模随机化URDF参数，但都无法支持躯干俯仰这类更丰富的行为，更未在多种真实硬件上验证。EAGLE真正改变的是“策略与本体绑定”这一默认假设——它让一个策略在多个异构机器人上同时工作，且不需要为每个机器人重写奖励函数。

这背后的动机很实际：人形机器人缺乏现成控制器，无法像操作任务那样通过遥操作收集数据，模仿学习管线在数据收集阶段就卡住了。EAGLE绕开这个瓶颈，用模拟器内的多本体训练加蒸馏循环，把“学会的技能”从专家回灌给通用策略，从而在不需要真实遥操作数据的前提下，实现跨本体泛化。

## 方法拆解

### 迭代式通用-专家蒸馏循环
每轮循环包含三个步骤：
1. **分叉**：从当前通用策略（generalist）复制出本体专属专家（specialists），每个专家只在对应机器人上微调。
2. **精炼**：专家在各自机器人上通过强化学习提升技能，专注于该本体的动力学特性。
3. **蒸馏**：采用基于DAgger的方式，将专家新学到的技能蒸馏回通用策略，在合并的本体集合上重新训练通用策略，重复直至收敛。

### 统一高维指令接口
基于HugWBC构建，指令向量编码四个维度：
- 线速度
- 角速度
- 身体俯仰角
- 基座高度

这个接口支持蹲起（通过基座高度指令）、倾斜（通过俯仰角指令）和速度跟踪，比现有方…

## Overview
We investigate a skill-based framework for humanoid box rearrangement that enables long-horizon execution by sequencing reusable skills at the task level. ent_paper_zhang_a_unified_perception_lan.body:
## 概述

本文提出一个统一感知-语言-动作（PLA）框架，由慕尼黑工业大学（TUM）团队开发，以GPT-4.1为核心推理引擎，整合摄像头、LiDAR、雷达多模态数据与结构化文本场景描述，实现可解释、自适应的自动驾驶决策。核心贡献在于将LLM的认知推理能力嵌入传统自动驾驶感知-规划管线，通过语言层弥合低层传感器数据与高层驾驶决策之间的语义鸿沟，并在nuScenes数据集上验证了速度预测与轨迹规划的有效性。

## 它改变了什么

传统自动驾驶系统在开放世界中的根本困境在于模块间信息断裂：感知输出的是无语义的边界框和点云，规划器需要的是可解释的交通场景理解，而语言模型擅长的是符号化推理。本文真正改变的并非某个算法模块，而是整个数据流形态——它将传感器融合结果转化为结构化文本文件，使LLM能够以“阅读场景报告”的方式参与驾驶决策，这实质上把自动驾驶从“几何计算问题”重构为“语义理解与推理问题”。

这一转变的意义在于：它首次让高层认知推理（如风险分析、意图判断）与低层几何感知（如3D检测、速度估计）在同一框架内协同工作，且决策过程可通过自然语言解释。对于安全关键系统而言，这种可解释性不是附加功能，而是验证与审计的基础——当系统在施工区选择减速而非变道时，工程师需要知道“为什么”，而本文的框架天然提供了这一答案。

## 方法拆解

### 三层架构
- **感知层**：360度摄像头图像由GPT-4.1直接解释；LiDAR点云经PointPillars架构提取特征并回归3D边界框；雷达数据经欧氏聚类形成物体级分组。LiDAR与雷达输出在速度和坐标校正块中整合，确保时间与空间一致性，最终生成50米范围内自车状态与障碍物的结构化文本文件。
- **语言层**：VLA架构接受多模态输入——摄像头图像经视觉编码器、结构化文本文件经分词器，两特征流整合后输入GPT-4.1。模型被指示评…

ent_paper_eco_energy_constrained_optimiz.body:
## 概述

本文提出 ECO，一种面向人形机器人行走与操作的能耗约束强化学习框架。作者来自（论文未明确具体机构，但基于 IsaacLab 与 PULSE-X 推断为学术与工业联合团队），核心贡献在于将任务指定完全交由感知接口（PDC），通过分层 RL 与条件 VAE 低层控制器，在无特权状态、无参考运动的前提下，实现视觉驱动的多任务人形操作，并在厨房场景中验证了跨任务泛化。

## 它改变了什么

它真正改变的是人形机器人视觉操作中“任务如何被指定”这一根本问题。此前方法要么依赖特权状态（精确物体位姿），要么用相位变量或自然语言作为接口，前者绕开了感知难题，后者要么缺乏空间精度、要么每个新任务都要重新训练策略。ECO 将任务指定完全交给感知本身——用视觉覆盖层、3D 箭头和手部颜色指示来编码“抓什么、放哪里、用哪只手”，这使得策略在训练时看到的输入与推理时完全一致，且任务无关。这一改变让多任务学习成为可能：桌面策略微调到厨房场景时，抓取能力直接复用，无需为新任务重训底层运动。

另一个改变在于运动生成范式。ECO 没有使用参考运动或模仿学习，而是用 PULSE-X（条件 VAE）作为通用低级控制器，将策略输出解码为类人动作。这打破了“高层策略必须直接输出关节力矩”的惯例，让高层策略只负责决策（选物体、定目标、控手），低层负责运动质量。这种分层设计显著降低了样本复杂度，使得 5×10^9 样本（约 4 年经验）即可收敛，而端到端视觉策略通常需要更多。

## 方法拆解

ECO 采用分层 RL 架构，核心是“感知即接口”（PDC）范式与 PULSE-X 低层控制器的结合。

### 任务指定：PDC 的视觉编码
- **物体选择**：2D 语义分割 + alpha 混合，目标物体亮绿色覆盖，抽屉把手亮红色区分。
- **目标位置**：3D 箭头渲染在智能体视野中，指示期望目…

ent_paper_hammad_a_comparative_study_on_.body:
## 概述

本文针对 SCITOS G5 壁跟随机器人公开数据集，系统对比了 7 种机器学习与 5 种深度学习模型在 24、4、2 传感器三种输入格式下的控制精度。作者提出决策树在简化输入上达到 100% 平均精度，梯度提升分类器在完整 24 传感器输入上达到 99.82%，并设计了一种带权重共享的深度前馈网络作为最优深度学习方案。核心贡献在于提供了该传感器融合问题上迄今最全面的算法性能基准，并纠正了先前文献中基于训练精度报告的虚高结果。

## 它改变了什么

这项工作的真正价值不在于又刷高了一个数据集上的精度数字，而在于它动摇了该领域先前报告的可信度基础。作者明确指出，此前多项研究（如 MLP、Elman 网络）报告的精度是基于训练集而非独立测试集，这意味着那些“高精度”可能只是模型对训练数据的记忆，而非对未知环境的泛化能力。在壁跟随这类安全关键任务中，这种虚报会直接误导后续研究者与工程选型——一个在训练集上完美拟合但在真实走廊中漏检裂缝的控制器，其后果是灾难性的。

更值得注意的转变是：当深度学习在视觉、语言等领域横扫一切时，本文用严格的 Monte-Carlo 交叉验证证明，在这个特定的超声波传感器融合问题上，传统机器学习（尤其是树模型）不仅不落下风，反而全面碾压深度学习。这并非否定深度学习的价值，而是提醒工程界：在低维、结构化、带噪声的传感器数据上，复杂模型未必优于简单模型，No Free Lunch Theorem 在工程实践中的体现远比论文标题更深刻。

  - **24 传感器**：完整原始读数。

ent_paper_bin_real_time_polygonal_semant.body:
## 概述

本文提出一套面向人形机器人爬楼梯场景的实时多边形语义地图构建系统，将各向异性扩散滤波、Sobel 法向量估计、Canny 边缘提取与 RANSAC 平面拟合全流程部署于 GPU，并引入卡尔曼滤波补偿垂直漂移。系统在单帧处理 7.5 ms 下达到 IOU 0.93、平面距离误差 2.1 mm，显著优于 PPRCoRT 与网格化 Elevation Mapping 基线。

## 它改变了什么

现有平面提取方法在无噪声仿真与真实深度相机之间存在巨大性能鸿沟（IOU 从 95% 以上跌至 80% 以下），根源在于忽略滤波对原始数据的影响。对人形机器人而言，落脚点安全要求更大的稳定区域，这一差距直接威胁运行安全。作者此前基于 supervoxel 的分割方案耗时严重，无法满足实时性要求。

本文真正改变的是将“滤波-梯度-边缘-拟合”整条计算链从 CPU 迭代迁移至 GPU 并行，使计算密集型算法在传感器周期内完成。同时，它放弃了传统网格地图表示，改用连续多边形语义地图，配合垂直漂移补偿，解决了爬楼梯时里程计漂移导致的地图错位问题。这一改变使实时高精度平面提取从实验室仿真走向实际机器人部署成为可能。

## 方法拆解

### 输入与预处理
- 输入：深度图像 + 机器人位姿估计（来自 VINS Fusion 里程计或 SLAM）
- 深度图传输至 GPU 内存，执行各向异性扩散滤波：
  ∂I/∂t = ∇·(c(‖∇I‖)∇I)，扩散系数 c 随梯度幅值增大而减小，保留边缘同时平滑噪声区域

### 法向量与边缘提取
- 使用 Sobel 算子计算梯度 G_x、G_y，法向量由 n_p = -K⁻¹ [G_x, G_y, 1]ᵀ 求得，K 为相机内参矩阵
- 对法向量图像执行 Canny 边缘检测，提取轮廓并简化为多边形

## Overview
The core innovation of FabriVLA lies in its lightweight architecture: it employs InternVL3.5 as the vision-language backbone, paired with a flow-matching action head. This action head processes interactions among action tokens through a gated self-attention mechanism, while integrating shallow VLM layers to enhance spatial context information. The model is trained via single-stage joint optimization, starting from a pretrained VLM and a randomly initialized action head. On the Meta-World MT50 benchmark, which includes 50 diverse tasks, FabriVLA achieves a 90.0% tier-average success rate, demonstrating that a compact model based on a 1B-scale VLM can effectively replace massive multi-billion-parameter backbones.

ent_paper_robotacdex_a_dexterous_visual_.summary: arXiv:2606.31836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the field of robot learning, large-scale and diverse demonstration trajectories provide the fundamental basis for enhancing robotic manipulation ability. We introduce RoboTacDex, a large, multi-modal, and diverse dataset of dexterous manipulation behaviors performed with a humanoid robot. Built on the publicly accessible humanoid robot Unitree G1, RoboTacDex consists of 6k trajectories covering 19 tasks, 23 skills, and interactions with 22 objects. RoboTacDex provides comprehensive records including multi-view RGB and depth information, tactile feedback, and detailed semantic annotations. Furthermore, the dataset features a variety of relatively challenging tasks that can only be completed by dual arms and dexterous hands, aiming to mimic human-like operational logic and simulate real-world manipulation complexity. To ensure data collection quality, we develop an improved multi-camera synchronization system to enable millisecond data synchronization and recording of modalities. In our experiments, we evaluate three representative imitation learning models on our dataset, analyzing their performance as well as their respective strengths and limitations across different task categories. Successful trial results and a moderate level of generalization capabilities across a suite of tasks indicate the effectiveness and diversity of the collected dataset. Our dataset will be open-sourced soon.

## Overview

This paper proposes a reinforcement learning algorithm based on intrinsic curiosity rewards. It learns a feature space through a self-supervised inverse dynamics model and uses the prediction error of a forward dynamics model as the reward signal, addressing the exploration problem in sparse-reward environments with high-dimensional visual inputs. The method was proposed by researchers from UC Berkeley and other institutions. Its core contribution lies in bypassing the difficulty of pixel prediction, enabling agents to learn navigation and exploration in 3D environments and games using only curiosity signals.

## Overview

Humanoid-DART proposes a self-supervised iterative trajectory augmentation pipeline that starts from sparse demonstrations, generates kinematic trajectories via a task-conditioned diffusion model, filters feasible samples with a physics-based evaluator, and progressively expands the behavior library through goal relabeling and curriculum sampling, ultimately training a goal-conditioned mobile manipulation policy. The authors claim this is the first iterative trajectory augmentation framework for learning goal-conditioned mobile manipulation skills on humanoid robots, achieving an increase in task-space coverage from 0.1% to 96.6% in Unitree G1 simulation.

ent_paper_stemvlaan_open_source_vision_l.summary: arXiv:2602.23721v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models integrate visual observations and language instructions to predict robot actions, demonstrating promising generalization in manipulation tasks. However, most existing approaches primarily rely on direct mappings from 2D visual inputs to action sequences, without explicitly modeling the underlying 3D spatial structure or temporal world dynamics. Such representations may limit spatial reasoning and long-horizon decision-making in dynamic environments. To address this limitation, we propose StemVLA, a novel framework that explicitly incorporates both future-oriented 3D spatial knowledge and historical 4D spatiotemporal representations into action prediction. First, instead of relying solely on observed images, StemVLA forecasts structured 3D future spatial-geometric world knowledge, enabling the model to anticipate upcoming scene geometry and object configurations. Second, to capture temporal consistency and motion dynamics, we feed historical image frames into a pretrained video-geometry transformer backbone to extract implicit 3D world representations, and further aggregate them across time using a temporal attention module, termed VideoFormer [20], forming a unified 4D historical spatiotemporal representation. By jointly modeling 2D observations, predicted 3D future structure, and aggregated 4D temporal dynamics, StemVLA enables more comprehensive world understanding for robot manipulation. Extensive experiments in simulation demonstrate that Stem-VLA achieves an average accuracy of 92.0% across the LIBERO subsets, and 86.0% on the long-horizon LIBERO-Long subset.

ent_paper_li_vision_language_foundation_.body:
## 概述

RoboFlamingo 是一个基于开源视觉语言基础模型 OpenFlamingo 构建的机器人模仿学习框架，由作者团队提出。其核心贡献在于证明通过冻结预训练 VLM 的大部分参数，仅微调视觉重采样器、门控交叉注意力层和策略头，即可在 CALVIN 模拟基准上实现超越现有专用方法的低级控制性能，为机器人从业者提供了一条低成本、易用的 VLM 落地路径。

## 它改变了什么

长期以来，视觉语言模型在机器人领域的应用被局限于高层语义规划，其输出是语言 token，与机器人所需的连续动作表示之间存在根本性的表征鸿沟。RT-2 虽然证明了 VLM 直接输出动作的可行性，但其依赖私有模型和超大规模视觉语言数据的联合微调，训练成本与数据门槛极高，普通实验室难以复现。RoboFlamingo 真正改变的是这一格局：它证明了公开可得的开源 VLM 足以支撑低级控制，且无需对模型主体进行昂贵的全量微调。这相当于把 VLM 从“需要定制火箭才能发射的卫星”变成了“可以搭载在常规火箭上的有效载荷”，让机器人研究者能够以极低的算力与数据成本，将强大的视觉语言先验注入到自己的策略中。

## 方法拆解

### 架构分解
RoboFlamingo 将 VLM 的视觉语言理解能力与序列动作生成解耦为两个独立模块：
- **视觉语言理解**：复用 OpenFlamingo 的预训练结构，包括 ViT 视觉编码器、perceiver resampler（将视觉 token 数从 N 压缩至 K）以及 L 层 transformer 解码器。其中 transformer 层从 LLaMA、GPT-Neox 或 MPT 等预训练语言模型复制并冻结，仅交叉注意力层在操作数据上微调。
- **动作生成**：显式策略头，默认采用 LSTM 架构。视觉语言嵌入经最大池化聚合后输入 LSTM，其隐藏状…

ent_paper_jiang_solami_social_vision_lan.body:
## 概述

SOLAMI提出一种面向3D自主角色的社交视觉-语言-动作（VLA）建模框架，旨在让虚拟角色具备感知、理解并响应人类社交交互的能力。该工作通过整合视觉、语言与动作生成，构建沉浸式人机交互系统，核心贡献在于将社交智能注入3D角色控制管线。

## 它改变了什么

现有VLA研究多聚焦于物理操作任务（如抓取、导航），忽视了社交交互这一人类日常高频场景。SOLAMI改变了“机器人/虚拟角色只需完成任务”的范式，将交互质量本身作为优化目标——角色不仅要“做对”，还要“做得像人”。它把社交信号（目光、手势、语言节奏）纳入动作生成条件，使3D角色从工具型执行器转变为可共情的交互伙伴。这一转向对VR/AR、游戏NPC、远程临场机器人均有直接意义。

## 方法拆解

### 架构总览
SOLAMI采用三阶段管线：感知编码 → 社交意图推理 → 动作生成。

### 感知编码
- 视觉输入：RGB-D图像流，分辨率224×224，经预训练视觉编码器（SigLIP-2）提取特征，每帧产生64个图像token（像素洗牌后）。
- 语言输入：用户自然语言指令，经SmolLM2 LLM编码，与视觉token拼接。

### 社交意图推理
- 使用Eagle-2 VLM（由SmolLM2与SigLIP-2微调）融合多模态token，取第12层（而非最终层）嵌入——经验表明中间层保留更多社交线索（如视线方向、肢体语言），且推理更快。
- 状态向量（角色关节角、速度）经具身特定MLP投影至共享嵌入空间。

### 动作生成
- 采用流匹配（flow matching）训练扩散Transformer（DiT），以推理得到的社交意图token为条件，生成10步动作块。
- 推理时仅执行动力学感知模块的初始前向步骤，每个观测仅通过VLM一次，避免重复解码。

ent_paper_cai_seeing_space_and_motion_en.body:
## 概述

本文提出 SSM-VLA，一种通过增强潜在动作（Latent Actions）空间与时间感知能力的视觉-语言-动作模型。核心贡献是 Farsighted-LAM 框架，利用冻结 DINOv2 特征编码几何先验，并联合预测未来 N 帧的潜在动作，以提升机器人操作在长时程任务中的鲁棒性与泛化性。实验在 CALVIN 基准上达到平均链长 4.38，显著优于现有方法。

## 它改变了什么

现有 Latent Action Models（LAMs）虽能从未标注视频中学习动作表征，但其瓶颈在于对空间几何与时间动态的建模过于粗糙。端到端训练的图像编码器往往偏向纹理与外观，忽略物体间空间关系与场景布局；而多数方法仅依赖稀疏两帧输入，无法捕捉细粒度运动过渡与长期依赖。这种双重缺陷导致潜在动作表示不稳定、语义模糊，在长时程任务中决策可靠性显著下降。

ent_paper_gao_super_lidar_intensity_for_.body:
## 概述

本文提出一种从稀疏 LiDAR 测量生成稠密反射率图像的新框架，核心贡献在于反射率补偿、多帧累积策略以及一个用于评估稠密反射率图像在回环检测与车道检测中效用的新基准数据集。作者通过实验证明，补偿后的稠密反射率图像在多种机器人感知任务中显著优于原始稀疏数据，且对光照变化具有更强的鲁棒性。

## 它改变了什么

LiDAR 反射率图像在机器人感知中的价值长期被低估，原因在于其测量值随距离和入射角剧烈变化，导致同一物体在不同观测条件下反射率不一致，下游算法难以直接利用。现有方法要么忽略这一物理特性，要么依赖复杂的标定流程，且缺乏公开基准来量化稠密反射率图像的实际增益。本文真正改变的是将反射率从“不稳定的一维测量”转化为“可复用的稠密视觉表征”，通过物理建模补偿和时序累积，使反射率图像在回环检测与车道检测中达到接近相机图像的可用性，同时保留了 LiDAR 对光照不敏感的核心优势。这一转变使得反射率图像不再只是点云配准的辅助特征，而是可以作为独立的感知输入参与高级任务。

## 方法拆解

### 反射率补偿模型
对同一材料物体，控制距离和角度为单一变量，采集多组数据，拟合反射率与距离/角度的关系，基于文中公式获得模型参数。补偿后同一物体在不同距离和角度下的反射率保持一致范围，在长距离（大于 10m）下验证补偿模型有效性。

### 多帧累积策略
采用 5 帧累积数据作为输入，理由是与 10 帧输入性能相当，而单帧输入因过于稀疏导致重建质量显著下降。10 帧输入虽指标更好，但忽略机器人运动中的里程计误差和移动物体影响。这一设计在重建质量与动态鲁棒性之间取得平衡。

### 投影模式
数据集包含全景投影（覆盖 LiDAR 传感器全视场）和虚拟相机投影两种模式。全景投影用于回环检测，虚拟相机投影用于车道检测，分别适配不同感知任务的空间表征需求。

ent_paper_z_1_efficient_reinforcement_le.summary: arXiv:2606.31846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising framework for robotic manipulation by connecting language instructions, visual observations, and continuous control. However, most existing policies remain limited by behavior cloning or supervised fine-tuning (SFT) from fixed demonstrations, which provides limited opportunity to improve from the policy's own failures. In this paper, we present Z-1, a reinforcement learning (RL) post-training framework for flow-based VLA models. Built on top of $\pi_{0.5}$, Z-1 uses only publicly released RoboCasa demonstrations for SFT and then applies a task-wise Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) strategy across $24$ standard RoboCasa tasks. To improve the efficiency and stability of online optimization, Z-1 combines shared-prefix rollout construction, tree-structured trajectory branching, completion-aware reward calibration, and selective joint training of VLM and Action Expert. Across all $24$ RoboCasa tasks, Z-1 achieves an average success rate of $80.6\%$, improving over its SFT initialization by $13.2\%$ points and outperforms the published sota models. These results show that systematic GRPO post-training can substantially improve flow-based VLA policies without additional private demonstrations.

ent_paper_humanoid_robot_acrobatics_util.body:
## 概述

HWC-Loco 是一个面向人形机器人鲁棒运动的分层强化学习框架，由目标跟踪策略、安全恢复策略和高层规划策略构成，通过动态切换低层策略来平衡任务性能与安全。该方法在 Unitree H1 和 G1 上验证，显著提升了复杂地形与高速指令下的成功率与抗扰能力，并保持了类人运动自然度。

## 它改变了什么

现有鲁棒运动控制方法要么依赖精确动力学建模，要么在强化学习中使用过度正则化或域随机化，导致策略保守或无法应对真实世界安全关键模式。HWC-Loco 真正改变的是将“性能-安全”权衡从静态超参数或隐式正则化中解放出来，显式地建模为高层策略的在线决策问题。它不再试图让单一策略在所有情况下都最优，而是承认目标跟踪与安全恢复本质上是不同目标，需要独立的策略与协调机制。

这一设计直击了 Sim2Real gap 的核心矛盾：部署环境中的扰动（如推搡、硬件噪声）是稀疏但致命的，而训练环境中的随机化难以覆盖这些长尾事件。通过引入一个专门训练的安全恢复策略，并让高层策略根据观测动态选择，HWC-Loco 将鲁棒性从“被动承受”转变为“主动应对”，这是对传统 max-min 鲁棒优化范式的一次实质性修正。

## 方法拆解

### 分层架构
- **目标跟踪策略 π₁**：最大化任务奖励，同时通过 Wasserstein-1 距离约束模仿 CMU MoCap 专家数据，使用带梯度惩罚的判别器 f_d 实现。训练目标为 max_π₁ 𝔼[∑γ^t (r_𝔗 - λ f_d)]，λ 为最优拉格朗日乘子，用 PPO 更新。

ent_paper_motion_planning_in_compressed_.summary: arXiv:2606.30940v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning methods have vastly expanded the capabilities of motion planning in robotics applications, as learning priors from large-scale data has been shown to be essential in capturing the highly complex behavior required for solving tasks such as manipulation or navigation for autonomous vehicles. At the same time, model-based planning algorithms based on search or optimization remain an essential tool due to their flexibility, efficiency, and the ability to incorporate domain knowledge via expert-designed algorithms and objective functions. We propose a new generative framework to unify these two paradigms. First, we learn an autoencoder with a high compression ratio and a latent space of hierarchically ordered, discrete-valued tokens. Leveraging both the dimensionality reduction and the hierarchical coarse-to-fine structure learned by this autoencoder, we then perform motion planning by directly searching in the latent space of tokens. This search can optimize arbitrary objective functions specified at test time, providing a large degree of flexibility while maintaining efficiency and producing realistic solutions by relying on the generative capabilities of the highly compressed autoencoder. We evaluate our method on nuPlan and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, showing how latent space search can be used for a variety of guided behavior generation tasks, achieving strong performance for closed-loop motion planning and multi-agent guided scenario synthesis without requiring any task-specific training.

ent_paper_rhinovla_technical_report_2026.summary: arXiv:2606.07383v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, but real-time deployment on edge hardware remains challenging. In this work, we identify VLM visual and context tokens as a major source of deployment latency: for GEMM-dominated projection operators, computation grows linearly with the number of input tokens when model dimensions are fixed. Motivated by this observation, we propose RhinoVLA, a deployment-oriented VLA model co-designed with the Huixi R1 edge SoC. RhinoVLA adopts a token-efficient Qwen3-VL backbone and a continuous Action Expert, reducing the VLM-side token and computation burden while preserving pretrained multimodal capability. To support cross-robot learning, RhinoVLA further introduces a unified interface that combines View Registry, 72D physical state-action slot space, and robotinstance LoRA, allowing heterogeneous robot observations and action schemas to be aligned under a shared policy. On the deployment side, RhinoVLA is optimized through hardware-aware compilation, mixed-precision execution, and parallel visual encoding. Experiments show that RhinoVLA achieves downstream performance comparable to {\pi}0.5 at a similar parameter scale, while reaching 11.69 Hz end-to-end inference on Huixi R1, meeting the 10 Hz real-time closedloop control target. The project will be open-sourced at https://github.com/HuixiAI/RhinoVLA.

## Overview
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a pivotal approach to learning robotic manipulation at scale by repurposing large pre-trained Vision-Language-Models (VLM) to output robotic actions. ## Overview

This paper proposes the VLK system, which synthesizes large-scale vision-language-kinematics triplet data in 3DGS-reconstructed scenes through a real-to-sim-to-real pipeline to train perception-locomotion-manipulation policies for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot. The core contribution is connecting 3DGS scene reconstruction with whole-body motion tracking into a complete data generation system, enabling end-to-end language-instruction-driven manipulation without human demonstrations, validated across 120 real-world trials.

ent_paper_embodmocap_in_the_wild_4d_huma.body:
## 概述

本文提出EmbodMocap，一个面向人形机器人全身拥抱笨重物体的强化学习框架，由香港科技大学（广州）团队完成。核心贡献在于整合预训练人类运动先验与神经符号距离场（NSDF），通过教师-学生架构从AMASS数据蒸馏运动学自然且物理可行的全身模式，并设计三阶段（接近、拥抱、运输）定制PPO策略。该方法解决了现有WBM方法因连杆几何简化导致的位置估计误差，以及行为克隆缺乏接触力等环境信息的问题，在仿真与真实世界实验中展示了跨形状尺寸物体的适应性与sim-to-real迁移能力。

## 它改变了什么

这项工作的真正改变，不在于又提出一个“能抱箱子”的人形机器人控制器——这类任务演示在仿真里早已泛滥。它改变的是**问题定义本身**：将全身操作（WBM）从“运动学可行”的范畴，推进到“几何感知驱动”的范畴。传统WBM方法把连杆简化成线段或骨架，用运动学关系估算空间位置，这在接触稀疏的场景下勉强够用；但一旦面对“拥抱”这种大面积、持续、动态的接触任务，连杆模型对表面几何的盲区就会直接转化为接触力估计误差，进而导致任务失败。作者用神经符号距离场（NSDF）替代了这种简化，让机器人不仅知道“手臂在哪”，还知道“手臂表面离物体表面有多远、在哪个方向”，这是从“关节空间规划”到“体空间交互”的范式转移。

更深层的改变在于**数据利用方式的转向**。现有基于行为克隆（BC）的交互策略之所以在真实世界部署中脆弱，根本原因不是数据量不够，而是人类运动数据集里压根没有记录接触力、地形几何、动态交互这些对物理交互至关重要的环境变量——你从视频里学到的“抱箱子”姿态，缺少了“箱子有多重、表面摩擦多大、重心在哪”这些决定成败的隐变量。作者没有试图去补全这些缺失的标注，而是绕道而行：用大规模人类运动数据训练教师策略，蒸馏出运动学自然、物理可行的动作先验，再把这个先验作为低维动作空间，让RL…
